ambivalent.s: Tom feels ambivalent about his job; he likes and hates it.
ambivalent.zh: 汤姆对自己的工作感到矛盾，既喜欢又讨厌。

rhetoric.s: The politician's rhetoric was strong, but his actions were weak.
rhetoric.zh: 这位政客言辞激烈，但行动软弱。

justice.s: Nine justices sit on the US Supreme Court.
justice.zh: 美国最高法院有九位大法官。

rule of law.s: Under the rule of law, even the president must obey the law.
rule of law.zh: 在法治之下，即使总统也必须守法。

assertion.s: The judge did not believe the man's assertion that he was innocent.
assertion.zh: 法官不相信那人关于自己无罪的主张。

disregard.s: He drove very fast in complete disregard of the speed limit.
disregard.zh: 他完全忽视限速，开得飞快。

vigilante.s: The vigilante caught the thief himself instead of calling the police.
vigilante.zh: 那名自发执法者没有报警，而是亲自抓住了小偷。

execute.s: The bank executed the court's order and froze his account.
execute.zh: 银行执行了法院的命令，冻结了他的账户。

disobedience.s: The students were punished for disobedience to school rules.
disobedience.zh: 学生们因不服从校规而受到处罚。

abortion.s: The state passed a new law on abortion last year.
abortion.zh: 该州去年通过了一项关于堕胎的新法律。

manifestation.s: Violence in the streets is a manifestation of public anger.
manifestation.zh: 街头暴力是公众愤怒的一种表现。

militia.s: The small town formed a militia to protect itself.
militia.zh: 这个小镇组建了民兵组织来保护自己。

law-abiding.s: Most citizens are law-abiding and never break the law.
law-abiding.zh: 大多数公民都是守法的，从不违法。

lynch.s: In the past, angry crowds sometimes lynched people without a trial.
lynch.zh: 过去，愤怒的人群有时不经审判就将人私刑处死。

inalienable.s: Life and freedom are inalienable rights that no one can take away.
inalienable.zh: 生命和自由是不可剥夺的权利，谁也拿不走。

answer.s: The company filed its answer to the complaint within twenty days.
answer.zh: 公司在二十天内提交了对起诉状的答辩状。

paradox.s: It is a paradox that a free country needs so many laws.
paradox.zh: 一个自由的国家却需要这么多法律，这是个悖论。

will.s: In her will, Mary left her house to her son.
will.zh: 玛丽在遗嘱中把房子留给了儿子。

connotation.s: The word "lawyer" has a negative connotation for many people.
connotation.zh: 对许多人来说，律师这个词带有负面含义。

bestow.s: The king bestowed land on his loyal soldiers.
bestow.zh: 国王把土地授予了忠诚的士兵。

eligibility.s: Your age decides your eligibility to vote.
eligibility.zh: 你的年龄决定你是否符合投票条件。

compensation.s: The driver paid compensation to the woman he hurt.
compensation.zh: 司机向被他撞伤的女士支付了赔偿。

estate.s: Tom holds an estate in the farm for his whole life.
estate.zh: 汤姆对这座农场享有终身的地产权。

deduction.s: You can take a tax deduction for gifts to charity.
deduction.zh: 向慈善机构的捐款可以作为税收扣减项目。

allocate.s: The city allocated more money to schools this year.
allocate.zh: 市政府今年给学校分配了更多资金。

real property.s: Houses and land are real property.
real property.zh: 房屋和土地属于不动产。

bureaucracy.s: The government bureaucracy made it slow to get a license.
bureaucracy.zh: 政府的官僚制让办执照变得很慢。

administer.s: A state office administers the program for poor families.
administer.zh: 一个州政府机构负责实施这项帮助贫困家庭的项目。

welfare.s: The family lived on welfare after the father lost his job.
welfare.zh: 父亲失业后，这家人靠福利救济生活。

uphold.s: The higher court upheld the judge's decision.
uphold.zh: 上级法院维持了法官的原判。

empower.s: The law empowers the police to stop dangerous drivers.
empower.zh: 这部法律授权警察拦下危险驾驶的司机。

motive.s: Money was the motive for the crime.
motive.zh: 金钱是这起犯罪的动机。

enact.s: Congress enacted a new law to protect clean water.
enact.zh: 国会制定了一部保护清洁水源的新法律。

lobbyist.s: A lobbyist for the oil company met with several lawmakers.
lobbyist.zh: 石油公司的一名院外游说者会见了几位议员。

impose.s: The judge imposed a fine of 500 dollars on him.
impose.zh: 法官对他课以五百美元的罚款。

desecration.s: Many people saw burning the flag as desecration.
desecration.zh: 许多人认为焚烧国旗是一种亵渎。

separation.s: After years of fighting, the couple agreed to a separation.
separation.zh: 多年争吵之后，这对夫妻同意分居。

malum in se.s: Murder is malum in se because it is wrong by nature.
malum in se.zh: 谋杀属于自然犯，因为它本质上就是错的。

homicide.s: The police are treating his death as a homicide.
homicide.zh: 警方正把他的死亡当作杀人案来处理。

assault.s: He was charged with assault for threatening to hit a man.
assault.zh: 他因扬言要打一名男子而被控威胁罪。

arson.s: He set fire to his own shop and was arrested for arson.
arson.zh: 他放火烧了自己的店，因纵火罪被捕。

theft.s: She reported the theft of her bike to the police.
theft.zh: 她向警方报案，说自行车被盗窃了。

malum prohibitum.s: Parking on this street is malum prohibitum, not wrong by nature.
malum prohibitum.zh: 在这条街上停车属于法定犯，本身并不邪恶。

prostitution.s: Prostitution is illegal in most American states.
prostitution.zh: 在美国大多数州，卖淫是违法的。

proscribe.s: The law proscribes smoking in public buildings.
proscribe.zh: 法律禁止在公共建筑内吸烟。

predictability.s: Clear laws give people predictability in their daily lives.
predictability.zh: 清晰的法律让人们的日常生活具有可预测性。

enforceable.s: A promise made as a joke is not enforceable in court.
enforceable.zh: 开玩笑作出的承诺在法庭上是不可执行的。

assurance.s: The landlord gave us his assurance that the heat would work.
assurance.zh: 房东向我们保证暖气会正常工作。

arbitrarily.s: A good judge does not decide cases arbitrarily.
arbitrarily.zh: 好法官不会任意地裁决案件。

due process.s: Nobody can be sent to prison without due process.
due process.zh: 未经正当程序，任何人都不能被送进监狱。

void.s: A contract to sell drugs is void.
void.zh: 贩卖毒品的合同是无效的。

vagueness.s: The court rejected the law because of its vagueness.
vagueness.zh: 法院因该法律模糊不清而否定了它。

pornography.s: The website was closed for showing child pornography.
pornography.zh: 该网站因传播儿童色情作品而被关闭。

serve.s: A man served the court papers on Tom at his home.
serve.zh: 一名男子在汤姆家中向他送达了法院文书。

precedent.s: The judge followed a precedent from an earlier case.
precedent.zh: 法官遵循了一个早期案件的先例。

lawsuit.s: Mary filed a lawsuit against the company that hurt her.
lawsuit.zh: 玛丽对伤害她的公司提起了诉讼。

ambiguous.s: The contract was ambiguous, so each side read it differently.
ambiguous.zh: 合同措辞不明确，所以双方理解各不相同。

statute.s: The state passed a statute that raises the minimum wage.
statute.zh: 该州通过了一部提高最低工资的制定法。

opinion.s: The judge wrote a long opinion explaining the decision.
opinion.zh: 法官写了一份很长的判决意见书来解释这一裁决。

beyond a reasonable doubt.s: The jury must find him guilty beyond a reasonable doubt.
beyond a reasonable doubt.zh: 陪审团必须排除合理怀疑才能认定他有罪。

ambiguity.s: The ambiguity in the rule caused a long argument.
ambiguity.zh: 规则中的含糊不清引发了长时间的争论。

legitimacy.s: People questioned the legitimacy of the new government.
legitimacy.zh: 人们质疑新政府的正当性。

monarchy.s: Britain is still a monarchy with a king.
monarchy.zh: 英国仍然是有国王的君主制国家。

bind.s: This contract binds both sides to keep their promises.
bind.zh: 这份合同约束双方信守承诺。

compliance.s: The company checked its compliance with the new safety rules.
compliance.zh: 公司检查了自己对新安全规定的遵守情况。

absolutism.s: Under absolutism, the king had total power over everyone.
absolutism.zh: 在专制主义之下，国王对所有人拥有绝对权力。

divine.s: Kings once claimed a divine right to rule.
divine.zh: 国王们曾声称拥有统治的神圣权利。

infallible.s: Even judges are not infallible; they make mistakes too.
infallible.zh: 即使法官也并非绝对正确，他们也会犯错。

doctrine.s: The court applied an old doctrine to the new case.
doctrine.zh: 法院把一项古老的法律原则适用于这个新案件。

secular.s: The US government is secular and has no official religion.
secular.zh: 美国政府是世俗的，没有官方宗教。

dethrone.s: The people rose up and dethroned the cruel king.
dethrone.zh: 人民奋起反抗，废黜了残暴的国王。

temporal.s: The church had spiritual power, and the king had temporal power.
temporal.zh: 教会拥有精神权力，国王拥有世俗权力。

immutable.s: Some people believe moral rules are immutable and never change.
immutable.zh: 有些人认为道德规则不可改变，永远不会变。

consent.s: The doctor needs your consent before the operation.
consent.zh: 手术前医生需要征得你的同意。

incorporate.s: The new law incorporates several rules from the old one.
incorporate.zh: 新法律结合了旧法中的几条规则。

natural law.s: Natural law says some rights come from nature, not from kings.
natural law.zh: 自然法认为有些权利来自自然，而不是来自国王。

invoke.s: The man invoked his right to remain silent.
invoke.zh: 这名男子援引了他保持沉默的权利。

endow.s: People are endowed with certain rights at birth.
endow.zh: 人生来就被赋予某些权利。

abolish.s: The state abolished the death penalty ten years ago.
abolish.zh: 该州十年前废止了死刑。

drastic.s: The city took drastic steps to stop the rise in crime.
drastic.zh: 市政府采取了激烈的措施来遏制犯罪上升。

implicit.s: There was an implicit promise that he would keep his job.
implicit.zh: 这里有一个默示的承诺，即他可以保住工作。

wherein.s: This is the courtroom wherein the famous trial took place.
wherein.zh: 这就是那场著名审判在其中进行的法庭。

accordance.s: The judge acted in accordance with the law.
accordance.zh: 法官的做法与法律一致。

whim.s: A king could change the rules at his own whim.
whim.zh: 国王可以心血来潮地改变规则。

adherence.s: Strict adherence to the rules keeps the game fair.
adherence.zh: 严格遵守规则使比赛保持公平。

inherently.s: Hurting a child is inherently wrong.
inherently.zh: 伤害儿童本身就是错误的。

convict.s: The jury convicted him of stealing a car.
convict.zh: 陪审团以偷车罪给他定了罪。

capital.s: Murder is a capital crime in some states.
capital.zh: 在一些州，谋杀属于死罪。

offense.s: Driving while drunk is a serious offense.
offense.zh: 醉酒驾驶是一种严重的违法行为。

disproportionate.s: Ten years in prison for stealing bread is a disproportionate punishment.
disproportionate.zh: 偷面包判十年监禁是不成比例的惩罚。

defendant.s: The defendant said he was at home that night.
defendant.zh: 被告人说那天晚上他在家。

sentence.s: The judge gave him a sentence of five years in prison.

contempt.s: The man shouted at the judge and was held in contempt.
contempt.zh: 那人冲法官大喊大叫，被判藐视法庭。

reconcile.s: It is hard to reconcile freedom with safety.

ascertain.s: The police tried to ascertain who started the fire.
ascertain.zh: 警方试图查明是谁放的火。

advocate.s: Every person on trial needs a good advocate.
advocate.zh: 每个受审的人都需要一位好的辩护人。

appeal.s: He lost the case but filed an appeal.
appeal.zh: 他输了官司，但提起了上诉。

justification.s: There is no justification for hitting a child.
justification.zh: 打孩子没有任何正当理由。

conscience.s: His conscience told him to tell the truth.
conscience.zh: 他的良心让他说出真相。

obligation.s: Parents have a legal obligation to care for their children.
obligation.zh: 父母负有照顾子女的法律义务。

overt.s: The man made an overt threat in front of many people.
overt.zh: 那人当着许多人的面公开发出威胁。

segregation.s: Segregation kept black and white children in different schools.
segregation.zh: 种族隔离让黑人和白人孩子在不同的学校上学。

proponent.s: She is a strong proponent of equal pay for women.
proponent.zh: 她是男女同工同酬的坚定支持者。

legislate.s: Congress has the power to legislate on trade between states.
legislate.zh: 国会有权就州际贸易立法。

refrain.s: Please refrain from talking during the trial.
refrain.zh: 审判期间请克制自己，不要讲话。

conviction.s: His conviction for theft made it hard to find a job.
conviction.zh: 他因盗窃被定罪，这让他很难找到工作。

positive law.s: Positive law is the law that a government actually makes.
positive law.zh: 实在法是政府实际制定的法律。

adage.s: An old adage says that ignorance of the law is no excuse.
adage.zh: 一句古老的格言说，不懂法律不是借口。

albeit.s: He won the race, albeit by only one second.
albeit.zh: 他赢了比赛，尽管只领先一秒。

legitimate.s: The company had a legitimate reason to fire him.
legitimate.zh: 公司解雇他有合法的理由。

unlawful.s: It is unlawful to sell beer to children.
unlawful.zh: 向儿童出售啤酒是非法的。

hold.s: The court held that the search of his car was illegal.
hold.zh: 法院裁定对他汽车的搜查是违法的。

pension.s: After forty years of work, he lives on a pension.
pension.zh: 工作四十年后，他靠养老金生活。

support.s: Tom pays child support to his former wife every month.
support.zh: 汤姆每月向前妻支付子女抚养费。

prevalent.s: Car theft is prevalent in this part of the city.
prevalent.zh: 汽车盗窃在城市的这一带很盛行。

recall.s: Angry voters called for the recall of the mayor.
recall.zh: 愤怒的选民要求罢免市长。

condemn.s: Many leaders condemned the attack on the school.
condemn.zh: 许多领导人谴责了对学校的袭击。

prohibition.s: The city has a prohibition on smoking in parks.
prohibition.zh: 该市禁止在公园里吸烟。

repeal.s: Congress repealed the old tax law.

legalize.s: Some states have legalized gambling in recent years.
legalize.zh: 近年来，有些州已经使赌博合法化。

legislative.s: Congress is the legislative branch of the US government.
legislative.zh: 国会是美国政府的立法部门。

implication.s: The implication of his words was that I had lied.
implication.zh: 他话里的含义是我撒了谎。

encompass.s: The word "property" encompasses land, houses, and cars.
encompass.zh: 财产这个词包含土地、房屋和汽车。

inherent.s: Every job has some inherent risks.
inherent.zh: 每份工作都有一些固有的风险。

substantive.s: Substantive law tells us what acts are crimes.
substantive.zh: 实体法告诉我们哪些行为是犯罪。

procedural.s: The case was thrown out because of a procedural mistake.
procedural.zh: 由于程序上的错误，此案被驳回。

outset.s: At the outset, the judge explained the rules to the jury.
outset.zh: 一开始，法官就向陪审团解释了规则。

prescribe.s: The law prescribes a fine for parking in the wrong place.
prescribe.zh: 法律规定了在错误地点停车的罚款。

intent.s: He had no intent to hurt anyone.
intent.zh: 他没有伤害任何人的意图。

imprisonment.s: He was sentenced to two years of imprisonment.

legislature.s: The state legislature voted to raise taxes.
legislature.zh: 州立法机关投票决定提高税收。

civil law.s: A fight over a broken contract falls under civil law.
civil law.zh: 因违约引起的纠纷属于民法范畴。

ground.s: Cruelty is a ground for divorce in many states.
ground.zh: 在许多州，虐待是离婚的理由。

action.s: She brought an action against her landlord over the broken heater.
action.zh: 她因暖气坏了对房东提起诉讼。

cruelty.s: The wife asked for a divorce because of her husband's cruelty.
cruelty.zh: 妻子因丈夫的虐待而要求离婚。

adultery.s: He found out about his wife's adultery and left her.
adultery.zh: 他发现妻子通奸后离开了她。

irreconcilable.s: The couple had irreconcilable differences and decided to divorce.
irreconcilable.zh: 这对夫妻存在无法和解的意见不合，决定离婚。

incompatibility.s: They ended their marriage because of incompatibility.
incompatibility.zh: 他们因性格不能相容而结束了婚姻。

kangaroo court.s: The prisoners were judged by a kangaroo court with no real rules.
kangaroo court.zh: 犯人们被一个毫无真正规则可言的袋鼠法庭审判。

charge.s: The police dropped the charge against him.
charge.zh: 警方撤销了对他的指控。

adhere.s: All players must adhere to the rules of the game.
adhere.zh: 所有选手都必须遵守比赛规则。

arbitrary.s: The boss made an arbitrary decision without giving any reason.
arbitrary.zh: 老板毫无理由地作出了一个武断的决定。

heinous.s: Killing a child is a heinous crime.
heinous.zh: 杀害儿童是骇人听闻的罪行。

entitled.s: Every worker is entitled to a day off each week.
entitled.zh: 每个工人都有权每周休息一天。

trial.s: The murder trial lasted three weeks in a small court.
trial.zh: 这场谋杀案审判在一个小法庭里持续了三周。

jury.s: The jury found the man not guilty.
jury.zh: 陪审团认定该男子无罪。

counsel.s: A person accused of a crime has the right to counsel.
counsel.zh: 被指控犯罪的人有权获得律师帮助。

constitution.s: The US Constitution protects freedom of speech.
constitution.zh: 美国宪法保护言论自由。

cruel and unusual punishment.s: Cutting off a thief's hand is cruel and unusual punishment.
cruel and unusual punishment.zh: 砍掉小偷的手属于酷刑。

marijuana.s: He was arrested for selling marijuana.

possession.s: The farmer has been in possession of the land for years.
possession.zh: 这位农民多年来一直占有这块土地。

defer.s: Lower courts defer to the decisions of higher courts.
defer.zh: 下级法院遵从上级法院的裁决。

loophole.s: The rich man used a loophole to avoid paying taxes.
loophole.zh: 那个富人利用漏洞逃税。

comply.s: The factory failed to comply with safety rules.
comply.zh: 那家工厂没有遵守安全规定。

technicality.s: He went free because of a small technicality.
technicality.zh: 他因为一个小小的细节问题而获释。

constable.s: The village constable arrested the drunk man.
constable.zh: 村里的治安官员逮捕了那个醉汉。

blunder.s: The police made a blunder and lost the evidence.
blunder.zh: 警方犯了一个大错，弄丢了证据。

framer.s: The framers wrote the Constitution in 1787.
framer.zh: 制宪者们于1787年起草了宪法。

tyrannical.s: The tyrannical ruler put his critics in prison.
tyrannical.zh: 那个暴虐的统治者把批评他的人关进了监狱。

provision.s: One provision of the contract covers late payments.
provision.zh: 合同中有一项条款涉及逾期付款。

bill.s: The Senate passed the bill, and it became law.
bill.zh: 参议院通过了该法案，它成为了法律。

aftermath.s: In the aftermath of the storm, many families had no homes.
aftermath.zh: 风暴带来的后果是许多家庭无家可归。

combatant.s: Enemy combatants were held in a military prison.
combatant.zh: 敌方战斗人员被关押在军事监狱里。

succumb.s: The mayor finally succumbed to public pressure.
succumb.zh: 市长最终屈从于公众压力。

suspend.s: The government suspended the law during the war.
suspend.zh: 政府在战争期间中止了这项法律。

administrative.s: She does administrative work in a government office.
administrative.zh: 她在一个政府部门从事行政工作。

administration.s: The new mayor improved the administration of the city.
administration.zh: 新市长改进了城市的管理。

regulation.s: New regulations limit how much smoke factories can release.
regulation.zh: 新规章限制了工厂可以排放的烟雾量。

eligible.s: You are eligible to vote at eighteen.
eligible.zh: 你年满十八岁就有资格投票。

safeguard.s: A fair trial is a safeguard against unjust punishment.
safeguard.zh: 公正的审判是防止不公正惩罚的保护措施。

prosecute.s: The state will prosecute him for theft.
prosecute.zh: 州政府将以盗窃罪对他提起公诉。

retribution.s: Some people see prison as retribution for crime.
retribution.zh: 有些人把监禁看作对犯罪的报应。

fine.s: He paid a fine of 100 dollars for speeding.
fine.zh: 他因超速缴纳了一百美元罚金。

feud.s: The two families had a long feud over the land.
feud.zh: 这两个家族因土地结下了长久的世仇。

prosecutor.s: The prosecutor asked the judge for a long sentence.
prosecutor.zh: 检察官请求法官判处长期刑罚。

tort.s: Hitting someone with your car can be a tort.
tort.zh: 开车撞人可能构成侵权行为。

prosecution.s: The prosecution of the mayor took two years.
prosecution.zh: 对市长的刑事诉讼耗时两年。

forum.s: The company chose a forum in New York for the lawsuit.
forum.zh: 公司选择了纽约的一家法院来审理这起诉讼。

settle.s: The two sides settled the case before trial.
settle.zh: 双方在审判前就此案达成和解。

abide.s: Everyone must abide by the court's decision.
abide.zh: 每个人都必须遵守法院的裁决。

judicial.s: Judges belong to the judicial branch of government.
judicial.zh: 法官属于政府的司法部门。

liability.s: The company accepted liability for the accident.
liability.zh: 公司承担了这起事故的责任。

damages.s: The court ordered the driver to pay 5,000 dollars in damages.
damages.zh: 法院判令司机支付五千美元损害赔偿金。

sue.s: Mary sued her doctor for a bad operation.
sue.zh: 玛丽因手术失败起诉了她的医生。

suit.s: The family filed a suit against the hospital.
suit.zh: 这家人对医院提起了民事诉讼。

double jeopardy.s: Double jeopardy means you cannot be tried twice for one crime.
double jeopardy.zh: 禁止双重危险意味着你不能因同一罪行受两次审判。

pursuance.s: The police acted in pursuance of the judge's order.
pursuance.zh: 警方遵照法官的命令采取了行动。

thereof.s: The owner sold the house and the land thereof.
thereof.zh: 房主出售了房子及其土地。

treaty.s: The two countries signed a peace treaty.
treaty.zh: 两国签署了一项和平条约。

oath.s: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.

limitation.s: The law sets a limitation on the hours children can work.
limitation.zh: 法律对儿童的工作时间设定了限制。

amend.s: Congress voted to amend the law.
amend.zh: 国会投票决定修正这部法律。

amendment.s: The First Amendment protects freedom of religion.
amendment.zh: 第一修正案保护宗教自由。

executive.s: The president leads the executive branch.

vest.s: The Constitution vests the power to make laws in Congress.
vest.zh: 宪法把立法权授予国会。

judicial review.s: Judicial review lets courts reject laws that break the Constitution.
judicial review.zh: 司法审查让法院可以否定违反宪法的法律。

review.s: The higher court agreed to a review of the case.
review.zh: 上级法院同意对此案进行审查。

interstate.s: Congress has the power to control interstate trade.
interstate.zh: 国会有权管理州际贸易。

commerce.s: The city depends on commerce with nearby towns.
commerce.zh: 这座城市依赖与周边城镇的商业往来。

establishment clause.s: The establishment clause stops the government from creating an official church.
establishment clause.zh: 政教分离条款不允许政府设立官方教会。

clause.s: One clause in the contract says no pets are allowed.
clause.zh: 合同中有一项条款规定不许养宠物。

subsequent.s: Subsequent events proved that he was innocent.
subsequent.zh: 随后发生的事情证明了他是无辜的。

ordinance.s: A city ordinance bans loud music after ten at night.
ordinance.zh: 一项城市条例禁止晚上十点后播放嘈杂音乐。

veto.s: The president used his veto to stop the bill.
veto.zh: 总统动用否决权阻止了该法案。

statutory.s: Workers have a statutory right to a minimum wage.
statutory.zh: 工人享有获得最低工资的法定权利。

appropriation.s: Congress approved an appropriation of money for new roads.
appropriation.zh: 国会批准了一笔修建新道路的拨款。

treasury.s: Tax money goes into the national treasury.

regulate.s: The government regulates the sale of medicine.

proclaim.s: The king proclaimed a new law across the land.
proclaim.zh: 国王在全国宣告了一项新法律。

allegedly.s: The man allegedly stole a car last night.
allegedly.zh: 据称，这名男子昨晚偷了一辆车。

outlaw.s: The city outlawed smoking in restaurants.
outlaw.zh: 该市宣布在餐馆吸烟为非法。

implausible.s: His story that a dog ate his homework sounds implausible.
implausible.zh: 他说狗吃了他的作业，这听起来难以置信。

defense.s: His defense was that he was in another city that day.
defense.zh: 他的答辩理由是那天他在另一个城市。

infringe.s: The new rule infringes on our freedom of speech.
infringe.zh: 新规定侵犯了我们的言论自由。

insofar.s: The rule is fair insofar as it treats everyone the same.
insofar.zh: 就其对所有人一视同仁而言，这条规则是公平的。

expertise.s: The lawyer has expertise in tax law.
expertise.zh: 这位律师在税法方面有专门知识。

delegate.s: Congress delegated power to an office to make safety rules.
delegate.zh: 国会授权一个机构制定安全规则。

regulatory.s: The government set up a regulatory office for banks.
regulatory.zh: 政府为银行设立了一个监管机构。

agency.s: A government agency checks that food is safe.
agency.zh: 一个政府行政机关负责检查食品是否安全。

commission.s: The city set up a commission to study crime.
commission.zh: 市政府成立了一个委员会来研究犯罪问题。

promulgate.s: The office promulgated new rules for drivers.
promulgate.zh: 该机构颁布了针对司机的新规定。

accountable.s: Leaders must be accountable to the people.
accountable.zh: 领导人必须对人民负责。

bureaucrat.s: A bureaucrat told me to fill out three more forms.
bureaucrat.zh: 一个官僚叫我再填三张表。

maxim.s: A legal maxim says that no one should judge his own case.
maxim.zh: 一条法律格言说，任何人都不应审理自己的案件。

unequivocal.s: Her answer was an unequivocal no.
unequivocal.zh: 她的回答清楚明白：不行。

interpretation.s: The two judges gave different interpretations of the same law.
interpretation.zh: 两位法官对同一法律作出了不同的解释。

self-defense.s: He said he hit the man in self-defense.
self-defense.zh: 他说他打那人是自身防卫。

case law.s: Case law comes from the decisions of judges.
case law.zh: 判例法来源于法官的判决。

contingency.s: We saved money for any contingency, like a car accident.
contingency.zh: 我们存了钱以防意外事件，比如车祸。

attorney.s: She hired an attorney to help with her divorce.
attorney.zh: 她聘请了一位律师处理离婚事宜。

custodial.s: Police must warn a suspect before custodial questioning.
custodial.zh: 在羁押讯问之前，警察必须先告知嫌疑人。

customary.s: It is customary to stand when the judge enters.
customary.zh: 法官进来时起立，是习惯的做法。

common law.s: Common law grew from the decisions of English judges.
common law.zh: 普通法源于英国法官的判决。

necessity.s: There was no necessity for the police to use force.
necessity.zh: 警察没有必要使用武力。

stagnant.s: Without new cases, the law would become stagnant.
stagnant.zh: 没有新案件，法律就会停滞不前。

dispense.s: Judges dispense justice in the courts.
dispense.zh: 法官在法庭上施予公正。

equity.s: Equity helped people when the old law was too strict.
equity.zh: 当旧法过于严苛时，衡平法会帮助人们。

formulate.s: The committee formulated a plan to cut crime.
formulate.zh: 委员会制定了一项减少犯罪的计划。

jurisdiction.s: This court has no jurisdiction over cases from other states.
jurisdiction.zh: 本法院对来自其他州的案件没有管辖权。

realm.s: Family matters are in the realm of state law.
realm.zh: 家庭事务属于州法的领域。

discretion.s: The judge has discretion to choose a lighter punishment.
discretion.zh: 法官有裁量权选择较轻的惩罚。

enactment.s: The enactment of the new law took two years.
enactment.zh: 新法律的制定花了两年时间。

caveat emptor.s: Under caveat emptor, the buyer must check the car before buying.
caveat emptor.zh: 根据买者自慎原则，买方必须在购买前检查汽车。

purchaser.s: The purchaser paid for the house in cash.
purchaser.zh: 买受人用现金支付了房款。

fraudulent.s: He made a fraudulent claim to get insurance money.
fraudulent.zh: 他提出欺骗性的索赔来骗取保险金。

applicable.s: This rule is not applicable to children.
applicable.zh: 这条规则不适用于儿童。

supersede.s: The new law supersedes the old one.

federalism.s: Under federalism, power is shared between the nation and the states.
federalism.zh: 在联邦制下，权力由国家和各州共同分享。

feasible.s: It is not feasible to build a new prison this year.
feasible.zh: 今年新建一座监狱是不可行的。

liable.s: The driver is liable for the damage to my car.
liable.zh: 司机要对我汽车的损坏负责。

taking.s: The government's taking of his land for a road was legal.
taking.zh: 政府为修路征用他的土地是合法的。

trespass.s: Walking on his farm without permission is a trespass.
trespass.zh: 未经许可在他的农场里行走属于侵入他人土地。

ownership.s: The two brothers argued over the ownership of the car.
ownership.zh: 兄弟俩为这辆车的所有权争吵。

revenue.s: The government collected more revenue from the new tax.
revenue.zh: 政府从这项新税中获得了更多税收。

code.s: The state's criminal code lists all the crimes.
code.zh: 该州的刑法典列出了所有罪行。

tax-exempt.s: Most churches in America are tax-exempt.
tax-exempt.zh: 美国大多数教会是免税的。

charitable.s: She gave money to a charitable group that feeds the poor.
charitable.zh: 她向一个救济穷人的慈善团体捐了钱。

service.s: Service of the papers must happen before the trial.
service.zh: 文书的送达必须在审判前完成。

ruling.s: The judge's ruling surprised everyone in the courtroom.
ruling.zh: 法官的裁决让法庭里的每个人都很惊讶。

discrimination.s: The company was sued for discrimination against women.
discrimination.zh: 这家公司因歧视女性而被起诉。

enforce.s: The police enforce the speed limit on this road.
enforce.zh: 警方在这条路上实施限速规定。

interracial.s: Some states once banned interracial marriage.
interracial.zh: 一些州曾经禁止异族通婚。

espouse.s: The young lawyer espoused the cause of poor workers.
espouse.zh: 这位年轻律师拥护穷苦工人的事业。

revocation.s: After three accidents, he faced the revocation of his driver's license.
revocation.zh: 出了三次事故后，他面临驾照被撤销。

exemption.s: Churches get an exemption from paying taxes.

free exercise clause.s: The free exercise clause protects people's right to practice their religion.
free exercise clause.zh: 宗教活动自由条款保护人们信奉宗教的权利。

contention.s: The lawyer's contention was that the contract was never signed.
contention.zh: 律师的主张是这份合同从未签署过。

inception.s: The club has had the same rules since its inception.
inception.zh: 这个俱乐部从一开始就一直沿用同样的规则。

tacit.s: By saying nothing, he gave his tacit consent.
tacit.zh: 他一言不发，等于给予了默示同意。

constitute.s: Taking a car without asking can constitute theft.
constitute.zh: 不经询问就开走别人的车可能构成盗窃。

exempt.s: Food is exempt from sales tax in this state.
exempt.zh: 在这个州，食品免除销售税。

override.s: Congress can override the president's veto with enough votes.
override.zh: 国会只要票数足够，就能使总统的否决无效。

eradicate.s: The city wants to eradicate drug crime from its streets.
eradicate.zh: 市政府想从街头根除毒品犯罪。

compel.s: No one can compel you to speak against yourself.
compel.zh: 没有人能强迫你作不利于自己的陈述。

burden.s: The burden of proof is on the person who makes the claim.
burden.zh: 证明的负担由提出主张的一方承担。

tenet.s: Equality before the law is a basic tenet of democracy.
tenet.zh: 法律面前人人平等是民主的基本信条。

substantiate.s: She could not substantiate her claim with any evidence.
substantiate.zh: 她拿不出任何证据来证实她的说法。

endorse.s: The governor endorsed the new plan for schools.
endorse.zh: 州长认可了学校的新计划。

unwarranted.s: The police made an unwarranted search of his house.
unwarranted.zh: 警方对他的房子进行了无正当理由的搜查。

dissent.s: One judge wrote a dissent because she disagreed with the others.
dissent.zh: 一位法官因为不同意其他法官的意见而写了异议。

offer.s: Tom accepted Mary's offer to sell her car for 2,000 dollars.
offer.zh: 汤姆接受了玛丽以两千美元出售汽车的要约。

propriety.s: People questioned the propriety of the judge's comments.
propriety.zh: 人们质疑法官那些言论是否适当。

affirmative.s: She gave an affirmative answer: yes, she would sign.
affirmative.zh: 她给出了肯定的回答：是的，她会签字。

zoning.s: Zoning rules do not allow factories in this neighborhood.
zoning.zh: 分区制规定不允许在这个街区建工厂。

embody.s: The Constitution embodies the idea of equal rights.
embody.zh: 宪法体现了平等权利的理念。

axiom.s: It is an axiom that no one is above the law.
axiom.zh: 任何人都不能凌驾于法律之上，这是一条公理。

corollary.s: A corollary of free speech is the right to criticize leaders.
corollary.zh: 言论自由的必然结果是有权批评领导人。

imperative.s: It is imperative that you arrive at court on time.
imperative.zh: 准时到达法院是绝对必要的。

remnant.s: This old rule is a remnant of the days of kings.
remnant.zh: 这条旧规则是君主时代的残余。

linger.s: Old ideas about women lingered in the law for years.
linger.zh: 关于女性的旧观念在法律中继续存在了很多年。

replete.s: The book is replete with real court cases.
replete.zh: 这本书充满了真实的法庭案例。

chronology.s: The lawyer made a chronology of the events before the crime.
chronology.zh: 律师为案发前的事件制作了一份年表。

criterion.s: Age is not the only criterion for a driver's license.
criterion.zh: 年龄不是获得驾照的唯一标准。

writ.s: The court issued a writ ordering the man to appear.
writ.zh: 法院签发了一份令状，命令该男子出庭。

extant.s: Only a few copies of the old law are still extant.
extant.zh: 这部古老法律现存的抄本只有寥寥几份。

edict.s: The king issued an edict banning all weapons.
edict.zh: 国王颁布了一道禁止所有武器的法令。

adulterer.s: In old times, an adulterer could be punished by death.
adulterer.zh: 在古代，通奸的男子可能被处以死刑。

belittle.s: Do not belittle the work of young lawyers.
belittle.zh: 不要贬低年轻律师的工作。

dowry.s: Her father paid a large dowry when she married.
dowry.zh: 她结婚时，父亲给了一大笔嫁妆。

adoption.s: The couple finished the adoption of a baby girl.
adoption.zh: 这对夫妇完成了对一名女婴的收养。

transaction.s: The bank keeps a record of every transaction.

lease.s: We signed a one-year lease for the apartment.
lease.zh: 我们签了一份为期一年的公寓租约。

party.s: Both parties to the contract signed it on Monday.
party.zh: 合同双方当事人在星期一签了字。

delineate.s: The report delineates what happened on the night of the crime.
delineate.zh: 报告描述了案发当晚发生的事情。

alteration.s: Any alteration to the will must be signed.
alteration.zh: 对遗嘱的任何改动都必须签名。

sealed.s: In old times, important contracts were sealed with wax.
sealed.zh: 在古代，重要的合同都用蜡盖印。

aristocrat.s: The aristocrat owned most of the land in the village.
aristocrat.zh: 这位贵族拥有村里大部分土地。

reign.s: During the king's reign, many new laws were made.
reign.zh: 在国王统治期间，制定了许多新法律。

commute.s: The governor commuted his death sentence to life in prison.
commute.zh: 州长将他的死刑减为终身监禁。

penal.s: The penal code lists the punishment for each crime.
penal.zh: 刑罚法典列出了每种罪行的刑罚。

servitude.s: In the past, poor people were sold into servitude.
servitude.zh: 过去，穷人被卖去受奴役。

plaintiff.s: The plaintiff says the company owes her money.

standing.s: He had no standing to sue because he was not harmed.
standing.zh: 他没有受到损害，因此没有原告资格。

summon.s: The court summoned him to appear as a witness.

render.s: The court rendered its judgment on Friday.
render.zh: 法院于星期五作出了判决。

judgment.s: The judgment ordered the company to pay Mary 10,000 dollars.
judgment.zh: 判决命令该公司向玛丽支付一万美元。

tribunal.s: A special tribunal heard the case of the war criminals.
tribunal.zh: 一个特别法庭审理了战犯案件。

inheritance.s: In old England, inheritance of land passed only to sons.
inheritance.zh: 在古代英格兰，土地遗产只传给儿子。

maternal.s: Her maternal grandfather was a judge.
maternal.zh: 她的外祖父是一名法官。

paternal.s: His paternal grandmother raised him after his parents died.
paternal.zh: 父母去世后，他的祖母把他抚养长大。

coexist.s: Different religions can coexist in one country.
coexist.zh: 不同的宗教可以在一个国家共存。

analogy.s: The judge drew an analogy between the two cases.
analogy.zh: 法官在两个案件之间作了类比。

premise.s: His whole argument rests on a false premise.
premise.zh: 他的整个论点建立在一个错误的前提上。

custom.s: By local custom, the oldest son takes over the farm.
custom.zh: 按照当地习俗，长子接管农场。

codify.s: The state codified its rules on marriage into one law.
codify.zh: 该州把有关婚姻的规则编纂成了一部法典。

vengeance.s: He killed the man out of vengeance for his brother's death.
vengeance.zh: 他为了报复兄弟之死杀了那个人。

offender.s: First-time offenders often get a lighter punishment.
offender.zh: 初次犯罪的罪犯通常会受到较轻的惩罚。

premeditated.s: It was a premeditated murder, planned for weeks.
premeditated.zh: 这是一起预谋的谋杀，策划了好几周。

kidnapping.s: The kidnapping of the rich man's son shocked the town.
kidnapping.zh: 富人儿子遭绑架一事震惊了全镇。

flogging.s: Flogging was once a common punishment for thieves.
flogging.zh: 笞刑曾经是对小偷的常见惩罚。

restitution.s: The thief had to make restitution by returning the stolen money.
restitution.zh: 小偷必须把偷来的钱返还原主。

strike.s: The Supreme Court struck down the law as unfair.
strike.zh: 最高法院以不公平为由宣告该法律无效。

convention.s: Many countries signed the convention on children's rights.
convention.zh: 许多国家签署了儿童权利公约。

commentator.s: A TV commentator explained the court's decision to viewers.
commentator.zh: 一位电视评论者向观众解释了法院的裁决。

apparatus.s: The state apparatus was used to watch ordinary citizens.
apparatus.zh: 国家机构被用来监视普通公民。

deliberative.s: Congress is a deliberative group that debates every new law.
deliberative.zh: 国会是一个审议性的机构，会辩论每一部新法律。

patrician.s: In ancient Rome, a patrician had more rights than a poor citizen.
patrician.zh: 在古罗马，特权贵族比贫穷的公民享有更多权利。

praetor.s: In ancient Rome, a praetor decided legal disputes.
praetor.zh: 在古罗马，由裁判官裁决法律纠纷。

legislation.s: New legislation will raise the driving age to eighteen.
legislation.zh: 新的立法将把驾驶年龄提高到十八岁。

indispensable.s: A good lawyer is indispensable in a murder trial.
indispensable.zh: 在谋杀案审判中，好律师是必不可少的。

rigorous.s: Law students face rigorous exams every year.
rigorous.zh: 法学院学生每年都要面对严格的考试。

conform.s: The new building must conform to safety rules.
conform.zh: 新建筑必须遵照安全规定。

discern.s: It was hard to discern who was telling the truth.

capacity.s: A young child lacks the capacity to make a contract.
capacity.zh: 年幼的孩子缺乏订立合同的行为能力。

validity.s: The court questioned the validity of the will.
validity.zh: 法院质疑这份遗嘱的效力。

persecute.s: The government persecuted people for their religion.
persecute.zh: 政府因宗教信仰迫害人民。

predominant.s: English is the predominant language in American courts.
predominant.zh: 英语是美国法院中占支配地位的语言。

autonomous.s: Each state is autonomous in running its own schools.
autonomous.zh: 每个州在管理自己的学校方面是自主的。

canon.s: Under canon law, the church judged marriage cases.
canon.zh: 根据教会法，教会负责审理婚姻案件。

corpus.s: Students study the whole corpus of Roman law.
corpus.zh: 学生们学习整部罗马法大全。

cornerstone.s: Free speech is a cornerstone of democracy.
cornerstone.zh: 言论自由是民主的基石。

precept.s: "Do not steal" is a basic moral precept.
precept.zh: 不可偷窃是一条基本的道德准则。

initiate.s: The police initiated an investigation into the fire.
initiate.zh: 警方对火灾发起了调查。

spur.s: Low taxes spurred the growth of small businesses.
spur.zh: 低税收刺激了小企业的发展。

jurisprudence.s: She studied jurisprudence at a famous law school.
jurisprudence.zh: 她在一所著名法学院学习法理学。

practitioner.s: He is a legal practitioner with twenty years of experience.
practitioner.zh: 他是一名有二十年经验的法律从业者。

methodology.s: The two law schools use a different teaching methodology.
methodology.zh: 这两所法学院采用不同的教学方法论。

venue.s: The trial's venue was moved to another city.
venue.zh: 审判地被改到了另一个城市。

entrust.s: She entrusted her savings to her lawyer.
entrust.zh: 她把积蓄委托给了她的律师。

attain.s: He attained his goal of becoming a judge.
attain.zh: 他达到了成为法官的目标。

paradigm.s: The case became a paradigm for later judges.
paradigm.zh: 这个案件成为后来法官遵循的范式。

jurist.s: The famous jurist wrote many books about law.
jurist.zh: 这位著名的法学家写了许多关于法律的书。

integral.s: Juries are an integral part of the American legal system.
integral.zh: 陪审团是美国法律制度中不可或缺的一部分。

codification.s: The codification of French law took many years.
codification.zh: 法国法律的法典化花了许多年。

fusion.s: The fusion of two court systems saved time and money.
fusion.zh: 两套法院体系的融合节省了时间和金钱。

compilation.s: The book is a compilation of famous court decisions.
compilation.zh: 这本书是一部著名法院判决的汇编。

inherit.s: Mary inherited her grandmother's house when the old woman died.
inherit.zh: 祖母去世后，玛丽继承了她的房子。

preeminent.s: He was the preeminent lawyer of his time.
preeminent.zh: 他是那个时代最卓越的律师。

merit.s: The judge decided the case on its merits.
merit.zh: 法官根据案件的是非曲直作出裁决。

parameter.s: The judge set clear parameters for what the lawyers could ask.
parameter.zh: 法官为律师可以提问的内容设定了明确的范围。

proposition.s: The court accepted the proposition that all men are equal.
proposition.zh: 法院接受了人人平等这一主张。

inquisitorial.s: In an inquisitorial system, the judge asks most of the questions.
inquisitorial.zh: 在纠问式制度中，大部分问题由法官提出。

assign.s: Tom assigned his right to the money to his sister.
assign.zh: 汤姆把他收取这笔钱的权利转让给了他妹妹。

hear.s: The court will hear the case next month.
hear.zh: 法院将于下个月审理此案。

full-blown.s: The small argument grew into a full-blown lawsuit.
full-blown.zh: 这场小争执发展成了一场全面的诉讼。

conformity.s: The house was built in conformity with city rules.
conformity.zh: 这栋房子是遵照城市规定建造的。

bar.s: After passing the exam, she joined the bar.
bar.zh: 通过考试后，她加入了律师界。

litigation.s: Litigation is often slow and costly.
litigation.zh: 民事诉讼往往既缓慢又昂贵。

advocacy.s: His strong advocacy in court won the case for his client.
advocacy.zh: 他在法庭上有力的辩护为当事人赢得了官司。

progeny.s: The rich man died without any progeny to inherit his land.
progeny.zh: 那个富人去世时没有后代来继承他的土地。

graft.s: Americans grafted English law onto their new country.
graft.zh: 美国人把英国法律嫁接到了他们的新国家。

totality.s: The judge looked at the totality of the evidence.
totality.zh: 法官审视了证据的总体情况。

epitome.s: He is the epitome of an honest judge.

sedentary.s: Farming led people to a sedentary life in villages.
sedentary.zh: 农耕使人们在村庄里过上了定居的生活。

schism.s: The argument caused a schism in the church.
schism.zh: 这场争论导致了教会的分裂。

sect.s: A small religious sect lived on the island.
sect.zh: 一个小的宗教教派住在这个岛上。

synthesize.s: The judge synthesized the rules from many old cases.
synthesize.zh: 法官综合了许多旧案件中的规则。

prevail.s: The plaintiff prevailed and won 3,000 dollars.
prevail.zh: 原告获胜，获得了三千美元。

potent.s: Fear of prison is a potent reason to obey the law.
potent.zh: 对坐牢的恐惧是守法的强有力理由。

incarcerate.s: The state incarcerates thousands of people every year.
incarcerate.zh: 该州每年监禁数以千计的人。

adversarial.s: In the adversarial system, two lawyers argue before a neutral judge.
adversarial.zh: 在对抗式制度中，双方律师在中立的法官面前辩论。

exclusionary rule.s: Under the exclusionary rule, illegally found evidence cannot be used.
exclusionary rule.zh: 根据证据排除规则，非法取得的证据不能使用。

uncodified.s: Britain has an uncodified constitution with no single written text.
uncodified.zh: 英国的宪法是未法典化的，没有单一的成文文本。

insular.s: The small island village was insular and distrusted strangers.
insular.zh: 这个小岛村庄很孤立，不信任外人。

treatise.s: The professor wrote a long treatise on contract law.
treatise.zh: 这位教授写了一部关于合同法的长篇专著。

kinship.s: In many villages, kinship decides who gets the land.
kinship.zh: 在许多村庄，亲属关系决定谁能得到土地。

stratification.s: Social stratification divided the town into rich and poor.
stratification.zh: 社会分层把小镇分成了富人和穷人。

amalgamation.s: The amalgamation of the two banks created one large bank.
amalgamation.zh: 两家银行的合并产生了一家大银行。

diminish.s: The new law diminished the power of the king.
diminish.zh: 新法律减少了国王的权力。

indigenous.s: Indigenous people lived there long before the Europeans came.
indigenous.zh: 早在欧洲人到来之前，本土居民就住在那里了。

sustain.s: The higher court sustained the lower court's decision.
sustain.zh: 上级法院确认了下级法院的裁决。

opinio juris.s: Opinio juris is the belief that a custom is legally required.
opinio juris.zh: 法律确信是指相信某种习惯在法律上必须遵守。

equilibrium.s: The law tries to keep an equilibrium between workers and owners.
equilibrium.zh: 法律力图在工人和老板之间保持平衡。

theocracy.s: In a theocracy, religious leaders also run the government.
theocracy.zh: 在神权政治中，宗教领袖同时掌管政府。

deed.s: He signed the deed and gave the house to his son.
deed.zh: 他签署了契据，把房子给了儿子。

appraisal.s: An appraisal showed the house was worth 200,000 dollars.
appraisal.zh: 评估显示这栋房子价值二十万美元。

denomination.s: People of every denomination came to the church meeting.
denomination.zh: 各个教派的人都来参加了教会聚会。

successor.s: The old king named his son as his successor.
successor.zh: 老国王指定儿子为他的继承人。

descendant.s: All his descendants share the family land.
descendant.zh: 他所有的后代共享家族土地。

principal.s: He paid back the principal and the interest on the loan.
principal.zh: 他偿还了贷款的本金和利息。

sole.s: She is the sole owner of the company.
sole.zh: 她是这家公司的唯一所有者。

lawgiver.s: Moses is remembered as a great lawgiver.
lawgiver.zh: 摩西被人们铭记为一位伟大的立法者。

dogma.s: The church punished anyone who questioned its dogma.
dogma.zh: 教会惩罚任何质疑其教条的人。

governance.s: Good governance needs honest and open leaders.
governance.zh: 良好的治理需要诚实而开明的领导者。

proportionate.s: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
proportionate.zh: 刑罚应当与罪行成比例。

deceased.s: The deceased man left his money to his daughter.
deceased.zh: 这位已故的男子把钱留给了女儿。

movable.s: Cars and furniture are movable property.
movable.zh: 汽车和家具属于可移动的财产。

asset.s: The house is the family's most valuable asset.
asset.zh: 这栋房子是这家人最有价值的资产。

collateral.s: He used his house as collateral for the bank loan.
collateral.zh: 他用房子作为银行贷款的担保物。

bloc.s: The countries formed a trade bloc to help each other.
bloc.zh: 这些国家组成了一个贸易集团，以便互相帮助。

exhibit.s: The lawyer exhibited the knife to the jury.
exhibit.zh: 律师向陪审团出示了那把刀。

dictatorship.s: Under the dictatorship, people could not vote.
dictatorship.zh: 在独裁统治下，人们不能投票。

proletariat.s: Marx believed the proletariat would rise against the rich.
proletariat.zh: 马克思认为无产阶级会起来反抗富人。

enforcement.s: Strict enforcement of traffic laws made the roads safer.
enforcement.zh: 交通法规的严格实施使道路更加安全。

adjudication.s: The adjudication of the dispute took six months.
adjudication.zh: 这起纠纷的裁判花了六个月。

municipality.s: Each municipality makes its own parking rules.
municipality.zh: 每个地方自治体都制定自己的停车规定。

judiciary.s: The judiciary must stay independent from the president.
judiciary.zh: 司法机关必须独立于总统。

confession.s: The police got a confession from the thief.
confession.zh: 警方取得了小偷的供述。

disseminate.s: The government disseminated the new rules through the internet.
disseminate.zh: 政府通过互联网传播新规定。

feudal.s: In feudal England, lords owned the land and farmers worked it.
feudal.zh: 在封建时代的英格兰，领主拥有土地，农民耕种土地。

mediation.s: The neighbors solved their fight through mediation, not a lawsuit.
mediation.zh: 邻居们通过调解而不是诉讼解决了纠纷。

antiquity.s: Some of these legal ideas date back to antiquity.
antiquity.zh: 其中一些法律观念可以追溯到古代。

mediate.s: A teacher mediated between the two angry students.
mediate.zh: 一位老师在两个生气的学生之间进行调解。

settlement.s: The company paid Mary 50,000 dollars in a settlement.
settlement.zh: 公司在和解中向玛丽支付了五万美元。

accommodation.s: The two sides reached an accommodation without going to court.
accommodation.zh: 双方未经诉讼就达成了和解。

arbitration.s: The workers and the company agreed to solve the dispute by arbitration.
arbitration.zh: 工人和公司同意通过仲裁解决争议。

minor.s: A minor cannot buy beer in the United States.
minor.zh: 在美国，未成年人不能买啤酒。

litigant.s: Each litigant must pay part of the court costs.
litigant.zh: 每个诉讼当事人都必须承担部分诉讼费用。

proceeding.s: The judge stopped the proceeding because a witness was sick.
proceeding.zh: 由于一名证人生病，法官中止了诉讼程序。

convergence.s: There is a convergence between American and European law.
convergence.zh: 美国法和欧洲法之间出现了趋同。

meld.s: The new system melds old customs with modern law.
meld.zh: 新制度把旧习俗与现代法律融合在一起。

anarchy.s: After the king died, the country fell into anarchy.
anarchy.zh: 国王死后，国家陷入了无政府状态。

restraint.s: The law places a restraint on the power of the police.
restraint.zh: 法律对警察的权力施加了限制。

pervasive.s: Fear of crime is pervasive in the city.
pervasive.zh: 对犯罪的恐惧在这座城市很普遍。

succinct.s: The judge gave a succinct answer in one sentence.
succinct.zh: 法官用一句话给出了简洁的回答。

legacy.s: Her will left a legacy of 1,000 dollars to her nurse.
legacy.zh: 她的遗嘱给她的护士留下了一千美元的遗赠。

grand jury.s: A grand jury decided there was enough evidence for a trial.
grand jury.zh: 大陪审团认定有足够的证据进行审判。

lord.s: The lord gave land to farmers who worked for him.
lord.zh: 领主把土地分给为他干活的农民。

manor.s: The lord lived in a large manor with many farmers.
manor.zh: 领主住在一座有许多农民的大庄园里。

tenant.s: The tenant pays rent to the landlord every month.
tenant.zh: 承租人每月向房东支付租金。

allege.s: The woman alleged that her boss had cheated her.
allege.zh: 那位女士宣称她的老板欺骗了她。

requisite.s: He did not have the requisite skills for the job.
requisite.zh: 他不具备这份工作所必需的技能。

testify.s: Three witnesses testified against him at the trial.
testify.zh: 三名证人在审判中作证指控他。

veracity.s: The jury doubted the veracity of his story.
veracity.zh: 陪审团怀疑他说法的真实性。

compurgation.s: Under compurgation, friends swore that the accused man was honest.
compurgation.zh: 根据共誓涤罪制度，朋友们发誓说被指控者是诚实的。

ordeal.s: In trial by ordeal, a person held hot iron to prove innocence.
ordeal.zh: 在神明裁判中，人要手握烧红的铁来证明自己无罪。

reparation.s: The country paid reparations after the war.
reparation.zh: 战后该国支付了战争赔款。

wergild.s: Under old English law, a killer paid wergild to the victim's family.
wergild.zh: 根据古英格兰法，杀人者要向受害者家属支付赎罪赔偿金。

vassal.s: The vassal promised to fight for his lord.
vassal.zh: 封臣承诺为他的领主作战。

grievance.s: The workers sent their grievances to the manager.
grievance.zh: 工人们向经理提出了申诉。

feudalism.s: Under feudalism, land was traded for loyalty and service.
feudalism.zh: 在封建制度下，土地用来换取忠诚和服务。

dominion.s: The king had dominion over all the land.

tract.s: He bought a large tract of land near the river.
tract.zh: 他在河边买了一大片土地。

reciprocal.s: The two countries made a reciprocal agreement on trade.
reciprocal.zh: 两国签订了一项相互的贸易协议。

serf.s: A serf could not leave the lord's land.
serf.zh: 农奴不能离开领主的土地。

appellate.s: He took his case to an appellate court.
appellate.zh: 他把案件上诉到了上诉法院。

seignorial.s: Seignorial courts were run by the local lord.
seignorial.zh: 领主的法庭由当地领主主持。

self-help.s: Breaking into a house to take back your TV is illegal self-help.
self-help.zh: 闯进别人家拿回自己的电视属于非法的自力救济。

overturn.s: The higher court overturned his conviction.
overturn.zh: 上级法院推翻了对他的定罪。

uniformity.s: The king wanted uniformity in the law across the country.
uniformity.zh: 国王希望全国的法律具有统一性。

consolidate.s: The king consolidated his power by building new courts.
consolidate.zh: 国王通过设立新法院巩固了自己的权力。

supplant.s: Royal courts slowly supplanted local courts.
supplant.zh: 王室法院逐渐取代了地方法院。

bolster.s: The new witness bolstered the woman's story.
bolster.zh: 新证人支持了这位女士的说法。

usurpation.s: The people saw the general's rise as a usurpation of power.
usurpation.zh: 人们认为将军的上台是对权力的篡夺。

demise.s: The demise of the old courts came slowly.
demise.zh: 旧法院的消亡来得很慢。

itinerant.s: Itinerant judges traveled from town to town to hear cases.
itinerant.zh: 巡回法官们从一个城镇到另一个城镇审理案件。

circuit.s: The judge rode the circuit twice a year.
circuit.zh: 这位法官每年两次到巡回审判区巡回审案。

entrench.s: Over time, the rule became entrenched in the law.
entrench.zh: 随着时间推移，这条规则在法律中得到巩固。

ecclesiastical.s: Ecclesiastical courts handled marriage and wills.
ecclesiastical.zh: 教会法院负责处理婚姻和遗嘱事务。

marital.s: Marital problems led the couple to divorce.
marital.zh: 婚姻问题导致这对夫妻离婚。

decree.s: The court issued a divorce decree last week.
decree.zh: 法院上周作出了离婚判决。

plea.s: The man entered a plea of not guilty.
plea.zh: 这名男子作出了无罪答辩。

bench.s: The judge sat on the bench and called the court to order.
bench.zh: 法官坐上法官席，宣布开庭。

taxation.s: Many people think taxation on food is unfair.
taxation.zh: 许多人认为对食品征税不公平。

viable.s: Building a bridge here is not a viable plan.
viable.zh: 在这里修桥不是一个可行的计划。

paucity.s: There was a paucity of evidence against him.
paucity.zh: 对他不利的证据十分缺乏。

facilitate.s: Computers facilitate the work of the courts.
facilitate.zh: 计算机促进了法院的工作。

fiscal.s: The government faces a fiscal crisis this year.
fiscal.zh: 政府今年面临财政危机。

chancery.s: He asked the chancery for help when the normal courts failed.
chancery.zh: 当普通法院帮不上忙时，他向衡平法院求助。

chancellor.s: The chancellor decided cases based on fairness.
chancellor.zh: 御前大臣根据公平原则裁决案件。

designate.s: The mayor designated the park as a no-smoking area.
designate.zh: 市长将公园指定为禁烟区。

sheriff.s: The sheriff arrested the thief in the next town.
sheriff.zh: 行政司法官在邻镇逮捕了小偷。

complaint.s: Mary's lawyer filed a complaint against the company.
complaint.zh: 玛丽的律师对公司提交了民事起诉状。

remedy.s: Money is the usual remedy for a broken contract.
remedy.zh: 金钱赔偿是违约的通常救济。

impoverished.s: Impoverished families often cannot pay for a lawyer.
impoverished.zh: 贫困家庭往往请不起律师。

complainant.s: The complainant told the judge that her neighbor hit her.
complainant.zh: 原告告诉法官，她的邻居打了她。

petition.s: Thousands of people signed a petition to save the park.
petition.zh: 数千人在一份拯救公园的请愿书上签了名。

laborious.s: Copying old court records by hand was laborious work.
laborious.zh: 手抄旧的法庭记录是一项费力的工作。

file.s: She filed a lawsuit against her employer.

allegation.s: The mayor denied the allegation that he took money.
allegation.zh: 市长否认了他收钱的指控。

relief.s: The plaintiff asked the court for relief from the noise.
relief.zh: 原告请求法院就噪音问题给予救济。

monetary.s: The judge gave him a monetary award for his injury.
monetary.zh: 法官因他受伤判给他一笔金钱赔偿。

substantial.s: There is a substantial difference between the two laws.
substantial.zh: 这两部法律之间存在实质的区别。

injunction.s: The court issued an injunction to stop the factory's noise.
injunction.zh: 法院发布了禁制令，制止工厂的噪音。

defy.s: The man defied the court's order and kept building.
defy.zh: 那人违抗法院的命令，继续施工。

intervene.s: The government intervened to stop the strike.

award.s: The jury awarded her 10,000 dollars for her injuries.
award.zh: 陪审团因她受伤判给她一万美元。

patent.s: The inventor got a patent for his new machine.
patent.zh: 发明者为他的新机器获得了专利。

absurdity.s: The judge pointed out the absurdity of the rule.
absurdity.zh: 法官指出了这条规则的荒谬。

equitable.s: The court gave an equitable remedy instead of money.
equitable.zh: 法院给予的是衡平法上的救济，而不是金钱。

specific performance.s: The court ordered specific performance, so he had to sell the house.
specific performance.zh: 法院判令特定履行，因此他必须出售房子。

performance.s: Performance of the contract was due in May.
performance.zh: 合同的履行期限是五月。

trust.s: Her grandfather set up a trust to pay for her school.
trust.zh: 她的祖父设立了一项信托来支付她的学费。

forge.s: He forged his father's name on the check.
forge.zh: 他在支票上伪造了父亲的签名。

redress.s: The workers asked for redress for their unfair treatment.
redress.zh: 工人们为所受的不公平待遇寻求补救。

substitutionary.s: Money is a substitutionary remedy when the lost thing cannot be returned.
substitutionary.zh: 当丢失的东西无法归还时，金钱就是一种代替性的救济。

compensatory.s: She received compensatory damages for her hospital bills.
compensatory.zh: 她获得了用于支付医疗费的补偿性赔偿金。

punitive.s: The jury added punitive damages to punish the company.
punitive.zh: 陪审团追加了惩罚性赔偿金来惩罚这家公司。

mandate.s: The voters gave the new mayor a mandate to cut taxes.

remedial.s: The court ordered remedial steps to fix the problem.
remedial.zh: 法院下令采取补救措施来解决问题。

restoration.s: The court ordered the restoration of the land to its old state.

indemnification.s: The company promised indemnification for any loss to its workers.
indemnification.zh: 公司承诺对工人的任何损失给予补偿。

whereby.s: They made a deal whereby Tom would pay half the rent.
whereby.zh: 他们达成一项协议，凭此由汤姆支付一半房租。

reimburse.s: The company will reimburse you for your travel costs.
reimburse.zh: 公司会偿还你的差旅费用。

pecuniary.s: He suffered a pecuniary loss of 3,000 dollars.
pecuniary.zh: 他遭受了三千美元的金钱损失。

assess.s: The jury assessed the damages at 8,000 dollars.
assess.zh: 陪审团将损害赔偿额确定为八千美元。

wrongdoer.s: The wrongdoer must pay for the harm he caused.
wrongdoer.zh: 违法人必须为其造成的损害付出代价。

egregious.s: Lying to the judge was an egregious mistake.
egregious.zh: 对法官撒谎是一个恶劣的错误。

intoxicated.s: The driver was intoxicated when he hit the tree.
intoxicated.zh: 司机撞树时处于醉酒状态。

detriment.s: The new rule works to the detriment of small shops.
detriment.zh: 新规定对小商店造成了损害。

incur.s: She incurred large debts to pay for her trial.
incur.zh: 她为了支付审判费用而招致了大笔债务。

reliance.s: He quit his job in reliance on her promise.
reliance.zh: 他出于对她承诺的信赖辞去了工作。

breach.s: Not paying the rent is a breach of the lease.
breach.zh: 不付房租是对租约的违反。

rectify.s: The bank quickly rectified the mistake in my account.
rectify.zh: 银行很快纠正了我账户中的错误。

purveyor.s: The shop is a purveyor of fresh food.
purveyor.zh: 这家商店是新鲜食品的供应者。

gloss.s: The teacher added a gloss to explain the hard word.
gloss.zh: 老师加了一条注释来解释这个难词。

obsolete.s: Many old laws about horses are now obsolete.
obsolete.zh: 许多关于马的旧法律现在已经过时了。

presuppose.s: Your question presupposes that he is guilty.
presuppose.zh: 你的问题预设了他有罪。

expound.s: The professor expounded his theory of law in class.
expound.zh: 教授在课上阐述了他的法律理论。

articulate.s: The judge articulated a clear rule for future cases.
articulate.zh: 法官为将来的案件阐明了一条清晰的规则。

intemperance.s: His intemperance cost him his job and his family.
intemperance.zh: 他酗酒成性，因此失去了工作和家庭。

harass.s: Her boss harassed her with phone calls every night.
harass.zh: 她的老板每晚打电话骚扰她。

groundless.s: The court said his complaint was groundless.
groundless.zh: 法院称他的控告是无根据的。

alimony.s: After the divorce, he paid alimony to his former wife.
alimony.zh: 离婚后，他向前妻支付扶养费。

maintenance.s: The court ordered him to pay maintenance to his wife.
maintenance.zh: 法院判令他向妻子支付抚养费。

null.s: The marriage was declared null because he already had a wife.
null.zh: 由于他已有妻子，这桩婚姻被宣告无效。

motion.s: The lawyer made a motion to delay the trial.
motion.zh: 律师提出动议，要求推迟审判。

nullification.s: Some states argued for the nullification of federal laws.
nullification.zh: 一些州主张废除联邦法律。

vestige.s: This custom is a vestige of an older time.
vestige.zh: 这种习俗是旧时代的残余。

assimilation.s: The assimilation of new immigrants took many years.
assimilation.zh: 新移民的同化花了许多年。

title.s: She holds title to the house.
title.zh: 她拥有这栋房子的所有权。

probate.s: After his death, his will went through probate.
probate.zh: 他去世后，他的遗嘱接受了遗嘱检验。

riparian.s: Riparian owners may use the water of the river.
riparian.zh: 河岸的土地所有人可以使用河水。

tenor.s: The tenor of his speech was clearly against the war.
tenor.zh: 他演讲的大意显然是反对战争。

hallmark.s: Fairness is a hallmark of a good judge.

merger.s: The merger of the two shops made one big store.
merger.zh: 两家商店的合并造就了一家大店。

abandonment.s: His abandonment of the house meant he lost his right to it.
abandonment.zh: 他放弃了这栋房子，这意味着他失去了对它的权利。

shackle.s: The new law freed workers from the shackles of debt.
shackle.zh: 新法律把工人从债务的镣铐中解放出来。

congenial.s: The two lawyers found each other congenial.
congenial.zh: 两位律师觉得彼此意气相投。

wholesale.s: The new government made wholesale changes to the law.
wholesale.zh: 新政府对法律进行了全盘的修改。

remainder.s: Tom paid half the price and promised to pay the remainder later.
remainder.zh: 汤姆付了一半价钱，并承诺以后支付剩余部分。

commencement.s: The commencement of the trial was delayed for a week.
commencement.zh: 审判的开始被推迟了一周。

ratify.s: The states ratified the new amendment.
ratify.zh: 各州批准了这项新的修正案。

incorporation.s: The incorporation of the small town into the city took a year.
incorporation.zh: 小镇与城市的合并花了一年时间。

accusation.s: He denied the accusation that he had stolen the money.

credible.s: The jury found the young witness credible.
credible.zh: 陪审团认为那位年轻证人是可信的。

therein.s: Read the contract and the rules therein carefully.
therein.zh: 请仔细阅读合同以及在其中所列的规则。

disseise.s: The lord disseised the farmer and took his land.
disseise.zh: 领主强占了农民的土地。

dispossess.s: The bank dispossessed the family of their home.
dispossess.zh: 银行剥夺了这家人对住房的占有。

banish.s: The king banished his enemy from the country.
banish.zh: 国王把他的敌人流放出国。

deprivation.s: Deprivation of liberty without a trial is unfair.
deprivation.zh: 未经审判就剥夺自由是不公平的。

suspension.s: He got a two-week suspension from school for fighting.
suspension.zh: 他因打架被学校暂停上课两周。

impeach.s: The House voted to impeach the president.

sovereign.s: In old England, the sovereign was the source of all law.
sovereign.zh: 在古代英格兰，君主是一切法律的来源。

entity.s: A company is a legal entity that can own property.
entity.zh: 公司是可以拥有财产的法律实体。

disrepute.s: His lies brought the court into disrepute.
disrepute.zh: 他的谎言使法院声名狼藉。

recovery.s: The plaintiff's recovery was limited to 5,000 dollars.
recovery.zh: 原告获得的赔偿额限于五千美元。

haphazard.s: Their way of keeping records was haphazard.
haphazard.zh: 他们保存记录的方式很随意。

constitutionality.s: The court will decide the constitutionality of the new law.
constitutionality.zh: 法院将对新法律的合宪性作出裁决。

layperson.s: Legal words are hard for a layperson to understand.
layperson.zh: 法律用语对外行来说很难理解。

restatement.s: Lawyers often read the Restatement of Contracts for clear rules.
restatement.zh: 律师们常常查阅合同法重述以获得清晰的规则。

stare decisis.s: Under stare decisis, judges follow earlier decisions.
stare decisis.zh: 根据遵循先例原则，法官会遵循先前的判决。

objection.s: The lawyer raised an objection to the question.
objection.zh: 律师对这个问题提出了异议。

waive.s: He waived his right to a lawyer.
waive.zh: 他放弃了获得律师帮助的权利。

scathing.s: The judge made scathing comments about the police.
scathing.zh: 法官对警方作出了严厉的批评。

contrive.s: He contrived a way to escape from prison.
contrive.zh: 他设法找到了一条越狱的途径。

virulent.s: The newspaper printed a virulent attack on the judge.
virulent.zh: 报纸刊登了一篇恶毒攻击法官的文章。

interrogation.s: The suspect was silent during the interrogation.
interrogation.zh: 嫌疑人在讯问中一言不发。

hypothetical.s: The professor asked a hypothetical question about a stolen bike.
hypothetical.zh: 教授提出了一个假定的问题，涉及一辆被盗的自行车。

pertinent.s: The judge asked for pertinent facts only.
pertinent.zh: 法官只要求提供有关的事实。

case at bar.s: The case at bar is different from the old one.
case at bar.zh: 在审案件与那个旧案不同。

meager.s: He lived on a meager pension of 300 dollars.
meager.zh: 他靠三百美元微薄的养老金生活。

dismal.s: The prison was dark and dismal.

detachment.s: A judge should look at each case with detachment.
detachment.zh: 法官应当以超然的态度看待每个案件。

hamper.s: Heavy snow hampered the police search.
hamper.zh: 大雪妨碍了警方的搜寻。

instill.s: Parents should instill respect for the law in their children.
instill.zh: 父母应当向孩子灌输对法律的尊重。

caprice.s: Laws should not depend on the caprice of one man.
caprice.zh: 法律不应取决于某一个人的怪念头。

collusion.s: The two companies were fined for collusion on prices.
collusion.zh: 两家公司因串通定价而被罚款。

dissolve.s: The couple asked the court to dissolve their marriage.
dissolve.zh: 这对夫妇请求法院解除他们的婚姻。

clerk.s: The court clerk keeps a record of every case.
clerk.zh: 法院书记官记录每一个案件。

bailiff.s: The bailiff kept order in the courtroom.
bailiff.zh: 法庭事务官维持法庭秩序。

barrister.s: In England, a barrister argues cases in court.
barrister.zh: 在英国，出庭律师在法庭上为案件辩论。

solicitor.s: She asked a solicitor to help her buy a house.
solicitor.zh: 她请了一位事务律师帮她买房。

lay.s: Lay people on the jury may not know the law.
lay.zh: 陪审团中的外行人可能不懂法律。

reprimand.s: The lawyer received a reprimand for being late to court.
reprimand.zh: 那位律师因出庭迟到而受到谴责。

disbarment.s: Stealing from a client can lead to disbarment.
disbarment.zh: 偷窃当事人的钱财可能导致被取消律师执业资格。

err.s: Even good judges sometimes err in their decisions.
err.zh: 即使是好法官，有时也会在裁决中犯错。

hone.s: Law students hone their speaking skills in class.
hone.zh: 法学院学生在课堂上磨练口才。

revile.s: The public reviled the man who hurt the child.
revile.zh: 公众辱骂那个伤害孩子的男人。

downtrodden.s: The lawyer spent his life helping the downtrodden.
downtrodden.zh: 这位律师一生都在帮助受压迫的人。

denounce.s: Church leaders denounced the new law as cruel.
denounce.zh: 教会领袖谴责这部新法律太残酷。

monolithic.s: The American court system is not monolithic.
monolithic.zh: 美国的法院系统并不是整体划一的。

hodgepodge.s: The town's rules were a hodgepodge of old and new laws.
hodgepodge.zh: 小镇的规则是新旧法律的大杂烩。

tumultuous.s: The trial took place during a tumultuous time in history.
tumultuous.zh: 这场审判发生在历史上一个动荡的时期。

indelible.s: The war left an indelible mark on the country.
indelible.zh: 战争在这个国家留下了不可磨灭的印记。

undertake.s: The lawyer agreed to undertake the case for free.
undertake.zh: 律师同意免费承担此案。

diversity.s: The case went to federal court because of diversity of citizenship.
diversity.zh: 由于双方州籍不同，此案进入了联邦法院。

court of last resort.s: The Supreme Court is the court of last resort.

notwithstanding.s: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the trial went on.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，审判仍在继续。

tedious.s: Reading old court records can be tedious.
tedious.zh: 阅读旧的法庭记录可能冗长乏味。

article.s: Article I of the Constitution deals with Congress.
article.zh: 宪法第一条规定了有关国会的事项。

authorize.s: The judge authorized the police to search the house.
authorize.zh: 法官授权警方搜查这栋房子。

ordain.s: The Constitution ordains that the president must be at least 35.
ordain.zh: 宪法规定总统必须年满三十五岁。

inferior.s: Congress created the inferior courts below the Supreme Court.
inferior.zh: 国会在最高法院之下设立了下级法院。

tantamount.s: Refusing to answer was tantamount to saying yes.
tantamount.zh: 拒绝回答等同于说了是。

removal.s: The removal of the judge needs a vote of Congress.
removal.zh: 法官的免职需要国会投票。

impeachment.s: The impeachment of the president shocked the nation.
impeachment.zh: 总统遭到弹劾，举国震惊。

pursuant.s: Pursuant to the contract, he must deliver the goods by Friday.
pursuant.zh: 遵照合同，他必须在星期五前交货。

confirmation.s: The Senate held hearings on the judge's confirmation.
confirmation.zh: 参议院就该法官的任命批准举行了听证会。

admiralty.s: Disputes about ships at sea go to admiralty courts.
admiralty.zh: 有关海上船只的纠纷由海事法院审理。

maritime.s: Maritime law covers accidents between ships.
maritime.zh: 海事法涵盖船只之间的事故。

federal question.s: A case about the Constitution raises a federal question.
federal question.zh: 涉及宪法的案件会引起联邦问题。

bankruptcy.s: The company filed for bankruptcy after losing money for years.
bankruptcy.zh: 这家公司连年亏损后申请了破产。

tier.s: The federal court system has three tiers.
tier.zh: 联邦法院系统有三个层级。

partisan.s: The vote on the new judge was very partisan.
partisan.zh: 对新法官的投票带有很强的党派色彩。

wrangling.s: After months of wrangling, the two sides finally agreed.
wrangling.zh: 经过几个月的争吵，双方终于达成了一致。

nomination.s: The president announced his nomination for the Supreme Court.
nomination.zh: 总统宣布了他对最高法院大法官的提名。

vacancy.s: The judge's death left a vacancy on the court.
vacancy.zh: 这位法官的去世使法院出现了空缺。

magistrate.s: A magistrate handles small cases like traffic tickets.
magistrate.zh: 治安法官处理交通罚单之类的小案件。

warrant.s: The police needed a warrant to search his home.
warrant.zh: 警方需要令状才能搜查他的家。

arraignment.s: At the arraignment, he heard the charges and said not guilty.
arraignment.zh: 在传讯时，他听取了指控并表示自己无罪。

preliminary.s: The two sides held preliminary talks before the trial.
preliminary.zh: 双方在审判前进行了初步的会谈。

hearing.s: The judge set a hearing for next Monday.
hearing.zh: 法官把听证安排在下星期一。

docket.s: The court's docket is full until next year.
docket.zh: 法院的待审案件表一直排到了明年。

misdemeanor.s: Stealing a cheap pen is only a misdemeanor.
misdemeanor.zh: 偷一支便宜的笔只是轻罪。

alleviate.s: The new courts alleviated the heavy workload of the judges.
alleviate.zh: 新设立的法院减轻了法官们沉重的工作负担。

preside.s: Judge Lee presided over the murder trial.
preside.zh: 李法官主审了这场谋杀案。

verdict.s: The jury reached a verdict of guilty after two days.
verdict.zh: 陪审团两天后作出了有罪裁断。

panel.s: A panel of three judges heard the appeal.
panel.zh: 由三名法官组成的合议庭审理了这起上诉。

en banc.s: All the judges of the court heard the case en banc.
en banc.zh: 法院的全体法官以全院庭审的方式审理了此案。

discharge.s: After the trial, the judge discharged the jury and thanked them.
discharge.zh: 审判结束后，法官解除了陪审团的职责并向他们致谢。

firearm.s: He was arrested for carrying a firearm without a license.
firearm.zh: 他因无证携带枪支被捕。

citation.s: The officer gave him a citation for speeding.
citation.zh: 警察因他超速对他发出了传讯。

municipal.s: Municipal courts hear cases about parking and small crimes.
municipal.zh: 市政法院审理停车和轻微犯罪案件。

opt.s: He opted for a trial by a judge instead of a jury.
opt.zh: 他选择由法官而不是陪审团来审判。

trivial.s: The court will not hear such a trivial matter.
trivial.zh: 法院不会审理这种不重要的事情。

bench trial.s: In a bench trial, the judge decides the case without a jury.
bench trial.zh: 在法官审判中，由法官在没有陪审团的情况下裁决案件。

justice of the peace.s: A justice of the peace married the couple in a small town.
justice of the peace.zh: 一位治安法官在小镇上为这对新人主持了婚礼。

coroner.s: The coroner said the man died from poison.
coroner.zh: 验尸官说这名男子死于中毒。

petty.s: Stealing a candy bar is a petty crime.
petty.zh: 偷一块糖果是轻微的罪行。

battery.s: He hit the man in the face and was charged with battery.
battery.zh: 他打了那人的脸，被控殴击罪。

holdover.s: The judge's black robe is a holdover from English courts.
holdover.zh: 法官的黑袍是英国法院的遗留物。

lobby.s: The farmers lobbied Congress for lower taxes.
lobby.zh: 农民们向国会进行院外游说，要求降低税收。

antiquated.s: The court still uses an antiquated computer system.
antiquated.zh: 法院仍在使用一套过时的计算机系统。

transcript.s: The clerk gave the lawyer a transcript of the trial.
transcript.zh: 书记官把庭审记录交给了律师。

whereas.s: Whereas the buyer has paid, the seller must deliver the car.
whereas.zh: 鉴于买方已经付款，卖方必须交付汽车。

trial de novo.s: In a trial de novo, the case starts again from the beginning.
trial de novo.zh: 在重新审理中，案件从头开始再审一遍。

juvenile.s: Juvenile offenders are sent to special courts.
juvenile.zh: 未成年的罪犯会被送往专门法院。

corporation.s: The corporation was sued by its own workers.
corporation.zh: 这家公司被自己的员工起诉了。

coincide.s: Her story coincides with what the witness said.
coincide.zh: 她的说法与证人所说的一致。

concurrent.s: State and federal courts have concurrent power over some cases.
concurrent.zh: 州法院和联邦法院对某些案件拥有并存的权力。

filing.s: The filing of the lawsuit cost him 400 dollars.
filing.zh: 提交这起诉讼花了他四百美元。

recover.s: She recovered 20,000 dollars from the driver who hit her.
recover.zh: 她从撞她的司机那里获得了两万美元的赔偿。

stake.s: Both families have a stake in the outcome of the case.
stake.zh: 两个家庭都与案件结果有利害关系。

felony.s: Robbery is a felony, so he may go to prison for years.
felony.zh: 抢劫是重罪，所以他可能要坐好几年牢。

penitentiary.s: He spent ten years in the state penitentiary.
penitentiary.zh: 他在州立监狱里待了十年。

uncontested.s: It was an uncontested divorce, so it ended quickly.
uncontested.zh: 这是一起无争议的离婚，所以很快就结束了。

intermediate.s: An intermediate court sits between the trial court and the supreme court.
intermediate.zh: 中级法院位于初审法院和最高法院之间。

exhaust.s: He exhausted all his appeals and went to prison.
exhaust.zh: 他穷尽了所有上诉途径，最后进了监狱。

attorney general.s: The attorney general is the nation's top lawyer.
attorney general.zh: 司法部长是国家的首席律师。

overrule.s: The Supreme Court overruled its earlier decision.
overrule.zh: 最高法院推翻了它先前的判决。

dilemma.s: The judge faced a dilemma: follow the law or show mercy.
dilemma.zh: 法官陷入困境：是依法办事还是网开一面。

unconstitutional.s: The court said the new tax was unconstitutional.
unconstitutional.zh: 法院裁定这项新税违宪。

pending.s: His case is still pending in court.
pending.zh: 他的案件在法院仍属待决。

moot.s: The case became moot after the two sides agreed.
moot.zh: 双方达成一致后，此案就失去了实际意义。

loath.s: The judge was loath to send a young boy to prison.
loath.zh: 法官不情愿把一个年轻男孩送进监狱。

prestige.s: A job at the Supreme Court brings great prestige.
prestige.zh: 在最高法院工作能带来很高的声望。

apocryphal.s: The famous story about the judge is probably apocryphal.
apocryphal.zh: 这个关于法官的著名故事很可能是杜撰的。

concur.s: Two other judges concurred with the decision.
concur.zh: 另外两位法官同意这一判决。

nominee.s: The president's nominee for the court met with senators.
nominee.zh: 总统为法院职位提名的被提名者会见了参议员们。

predecessor.s: The new judge changed many rules made by his predecessor.
predecessor.zh: 新法官改变了他前任制定的许多规则。

ideology.s: Judges should not let ideology decide their cases.
ideology.zh: 法官不应让意识形态左右他们的判决。

competence.s: Nobody doubts the competence of this lawyer.
competence.zh: 没有人怀疑这位律师的能力。

spouse.s: A spouse cannot be forced to testify against the other.
spouse.zh: 配偶不能被强迫作证指控另一方。

affiliation.s: The judge's party affiliation should not matter.
affiliation.zh: 法官的党派隶属关系不应产生影响。

covenant.s: A covenant in the deed says no one may build a fence.
covenant.zh: 契据中的一项协议规定任何人都不得修建围栏。

stance.s: The senator took a strong stance against the death penalty.
stance.zh: 这位参议员在反对死刑问题上立场坚定。

integrity.s: A judge must be a person of integrity.
integrity.zh: 法官必须是一个正直的人。

temperament.s: He has the calm temperament of a good judge.
temperament.zh: 他具有好法官那种冷静的性情。

testimony.s: Her testimony helped the jury find the truth.
testimony.zh: 她的证言帮助陪审团找到了真相。

incompetent.s: A very sick old man may be incompetent to make a will.
incompetent.zh: 病重的老人可能无行为能力订立遗嘱。

scrutiny.s: The judge's past came under close scrutiny.
scrutiny.zh: 这位法官的过去受到了严格审查。

coalition.s: A coalition of groups fought against the new law.
coalition.zh: 多个团体组成的联盟反对这部新法律。

derail.s: One old mistake derailed his hope of becoming a judge.
derail.zh: 一个陈年错误阻碍了他成为法官的希望。

prerogative.s: Choosing judges is the president's prerogative.
prerogative.zh: 挑选法官是总统的特权。

senatorial courtesy.s: Under senatorial courtesy, the president asks senators from that state first.
senatorial courtesy.zh: 根据参议员礼让惯例，总统会先征询该州参议员的意见。

objectionable.s: The judge found his words objectionable and stopped him.
objectionable.zh: 法官认为他的话令人反感，便制止了他。

alienate.s: The owner may alienate his land by selling it.
alienate.zh: 所有人可以通过出售来转让他的土地。

onus.s: The onus is on the plaintiff to prove the claim.
onus.zh: 证明这一主张的责任在原告。

faction.s: Two factions in the party fought over the new judge.
faction.zh: 党内两个派别为新法官人选争斗。

dictate.s: Money should not dictate who wins a case.
dictate.zh: 金钱不应支配谁赢得官司。

perception.s: Public perception of the courts is very important.
perception.zh: 公众对法院的看法非常重要。

preconceived.s: A juror must not have preconceived ideas about the case.
preconceived.zh: 陪审员对案件不得抱有先入为主的看法。

constructionist.s: A strict constructionist reads the Constitution word by word.
constructionist.zh: 严格解释论者逐字解读宪法。

incongruent.s: His words were incongruent with his actions.

consideration.s: In this contract, the money paid is the consideration.
consideration.zh: 在这份合同中，所支付的钱就是对价。

parity.s: Women workers demanded pay parity with men.
parity.zh: 女工们要求与男性薪酬对等。

profess.s: He professed his innocence to the very end.
profess.zh: 他直到最后都公开表示自己无罪。

devise.s: She devised her farm to her nephew in her will.
devise.zh: 她在遗嘱中把农场遗赠给了侄子。

disgruntled.s: A disgruntled worker sued the company.
disgruntled.zh: 一名心怀不满的工人起诉了公司。

prejudice.s: The jury must decide without prejudice against the defendant.
prejudice.zh: 陪审团必须在对被告不抱偏见的情况下作出裁决。

thwart.s: The police thwarted the robbery at the bank.
thwart.zh: 警方阻挠了这起银行抢劫。

caliber.s: The company hires lawyers of the highest caliber.
caliber.zh: 这家公司只聘用才干最出众的律师。

prominence.s: The young lawyer rose to prominence after a famous case.
prominence.zh: 这位年轻律师在一起著名案件后变得显赫。

solicitor general.s: The solicitor general argues for the government before the Supreme Court.
solicitor general.zh: 副总检察长在最高法院代表政府出庭辩论。

patronage.s: The mayor used patronage to give jobs to his friends.
patronage.zh: 市长利用任命权给朋友安排工作。

nonpartisan.s: Judges in this state are chosen in nonpartisan elections.
nonpartisan.zh: 这个州的法官通过无党派选举产生。

vie.s: Three lawyers vied for the open seat on the court.
vie.zh: 三位律师竞争法院的空缺席位。

plurality.s: She won with a plurality, not a majority, of the votes.
plurality.zh: 她以相对多数而非绝对多数的选票获胜。

undermine.s: Lies by the police undermine trust in the law.
undermine.zh: 警察的谎言削弱了人们对法律的信任。

reprisal.s: Workers feared reprisal if they told the truth.
reprisal.zh: 工人们担心说出真相会遭到报复。

incumbent.s: The incumbent lost the election to a young lawyer.
incumbent.zh: 那位在任的公职人员在选举中输给了一位年轻律师。

unseat.s: Voters unseated the judge after his bad decisions.
unseat.zh: 由于那位法官判决失当，选民让他落选了。

demean.s: Rude jokes demean the dignity of the court.
demean.zh: 粗俗的笑话贬低了法庭的尊严。

solicit.s: Judges may not solicit money from lawyers.
solicit.zh: 法官不得向律师要求钱款。

bias.s: The judge had a bias against poor people.

onerous.s: The new rules put an onerous burden on small businesses.
onerous.zh: 新规定给小企业带来了过度繁重的负担。

cronyism.s: The mayor was accused of cronyism for hiring his friends.
cronyism.zh: 市长因雇用朋友而被指责任人唯亲。

credential.s: She showed her credentials before speaking in court.
credential.zh: 她在法庭发言前出示了自己的证明书。

tenure.s: Federal judges have tenure for life.
tenure.zh: 联邦法官终身保有其职位。

retention.s: Voters decide on the retention of judges every six years.
retention.zh: 选民每六年决定一次法官是否留任。

probationary.s: New teachers work a probationary period of one year.
probationary.zh: 新教师有一年的试用期。

tyranny.s: The people fought against the tyranny of the king.

thereby.s: He signed the paper, thereby giving up his rights.
thereby.zh: 他在文件上签了字，从而放弃了自己的权利。

inordinate.s: The trial took an inordinate amount of time.
inordinate.zh: 这场审判耗费了过多的时间。

unduly.s: The punishment seemed unduly harsh for a first offense.
unduly.zh: 对初犯来说，这一惩罚似乎过于严厉。

conclusive.s: The blood test gave conclusive proof that he was the father.
conclusive.zh: 血液检测提供了他是父亲的决定性证据。

misconduct.s: The officer was fired for misconduct.
misconduct.zh: 那名警官因不当行为被解雇。

counterpart.s: The US Attorney General met his Chinese counterpart.
counterpart.zh: 美国司法部长会见了中国的对应官员。

susceptible.s: Young people are susceptible to pressure from friends.
susceptible.zh: 年轻人容易受到朋友压力的影响。

bribe.s: He tried to bribe the judge with cash.
bribe.zh: 他试图用现金贿赂法官。

perjury.s: She was charged with perjury for lying in court.
perjury.zh: 她因在法庭上撒谎被控伪证罪。

impeachable.s: Taking bribes is an impeachable offense for a judge.
impeachable.zh: 对法官来说，受贿是可弹劾的罪行。

berate.s: The judge berated the lawyer for being late again.
berate.zh: 法官严厉斥责那位律师再次迟到。

impropriety.s: A judge must avoid even the appearance of impropriety.
impropriety.zh: 法官必须避免哪怕是表面上的不当行为。

censure.s: The judge received a public censure for his rude words.
censure.zh: 那位法官因言语粗鲁而受到公开谴责。

mandatory.s: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory in this state.
mandatory.zh: 在这个州，系安全带是强制的。

senility.s: Old age and senility forced the judge to retire.
senility.zh: 年老衰迈迫使那位法官退休。

disqualification.s: Drunk driving led to his disqualification from driving for a year.
disqualification.zh: 醉驾导致他被取消驾驶资格一年。

thorny.s: Abortion is a thorny issue for many judges.
thorny.zh: 堕胎对许多法官来说是个棘手的问题。

foremost.s: Safety is the foremost concern of the new law.
foremost.zh: 安全是新法律首要关心的问题。

intemperate.s: The senator made intemperate remarks about the judge.
intemperate.zh: 那位参议员对法官发表了无节制的言论。

outspoken.s: She is an outspoken critic of the death penalty.
outspoken.zh: 她是一位直言不讳批评死刑的人。

disgrace.s: The judge left office in disgrace.
disgrace.zh: 那位法官带着耻辱离职了。

acquit.s: The jury acquitted him of murder.
acquit.zh: 陪审团宣告他谋杀罪无罪。

brief.s: Law students write a brief of each case they read.
brief.zh: 法学院学生为读过的每个案例写一份判词摘要。

non-justiciable.s: The court said the political question was non-justiciable.
non-justiciable.zh: 法院称这个政治问题不应由司法机构受理。

dismiss.s: The judge dismissed the case for lack of evidence.
dismiss.zh: 法官以证据不足为由驳回了此案。

insanity.s: He was found not guilty because of insanity.
insanity.zh: 他因患精神病被判无罪。

evasion.s: The rich man went to prison for tax evasion.

bribery.s: The mayor was arrested for bribery last week.
bribery.zh: 市长上周因贿赂罪被捕。

harassment.s: She reported harassment by her boss to the police.
harassment.zh: 她向警方举报了老板对她的骚扰。

cumbersome.s: The old rules for filing a case were cumbersome.

ignominious.s: The judge suffered an ignominious fall from power.
ignominious.zh: 那位法官可耻地失去了权力。

partiality.s: The judge was accused of partiality toward his friend.
partiality.zh: 法官被指控偏袒他的朋友。

oppression.s: The people suffered years of oppression under the king.
oppression.zh: 人民在国王统治下遭受了多年的压迫。

treason.s: He was hanged for treason against the king.
treason.zh: 他因背叛国王犯叛国罪被绞死。

high crimes and misdemeanors.s: A president can be removed for high crimes and misdemeanors.
high crimes and misdemeanors.zh: 总统可能因严重犯罪与轻罪被免职。

disciplinary.s: The bar took disciplinary action against the lawyer.
disciplinary.zh: 律师协会对那位律师采取了惩戒措施。

assignment.s: The assignment of the lease to Tom needs the landlord's consent.
assignment.zh: 将租约转让给汤姆需要房东的同意。

legislative address.s: By legislative address, lawmakers asked the governor to remove the judge.
legislative address.zh: 通过议会请求免职程序，议员们要求州长罢免这位法官。

indictable.s: Stealing a car is an indictable offense in this state.
indictable.zh: 在这个州，偷车是可被提起公诉的罪行。

indignity.s: The prisoners suffered the indignity of being searched in public.
indignity.zh: 囚犯们遭受了当众搜身的侮辱。

expiration.s: At the expiration of the lease, they must move out.
expiration.zh: 租约期满时，他们必须搬走。

deem.s: The court deemed the contract unfair to the buyer.
deem.zh: 法院将该合同视为对买方不公平。

rape.s: He was sent to prison for rape.

unfounded.s: The rumors about the judge proved unfounded.
unfounded.zh: 关于法官的传言被证明是无根据的。

hereafter.s: Hereafter, all visitors must show an ID card.
hereafter.zh: 此后，所有来访者都必须出示身份证。

strict scrutiny.s: Laws that treat people differently by race face strict scrutiny.
strict scrutiny.zh: 按种族区别对待人们的法律要接受严格审查。

solicitation.s: Solicitation of clients at a hospital is not allowed for lawyers.
solicitation.zh: 律师不得在医院招揽客户。

compelling state interest.s: The state must show a compelling state interest to limit free speech.
compelling state interest.zh: 州政府必须证明存在必要的国家利益才能限制言论自由。

impartial.s: A judge must be impartial and treat both sides equally.
impartial.zh: 法官必须公正，平等对待双方。

infringement.s: Copying the song without asking was an infringement of copyright.
infringement.zh: 未经许可复制这首歌是对版权的侵犯。

accountability.s: Voters want more accountability from their judges.
accountability.zh: 选民希望对法官进行更多问责。

implied.s: By taking the job, he gave implied consent to the rules.
implied.zh: 接受这份工作，就等于他对这些规则作出了默示的同意。

elaborate.s: The witness refused to elaborate on her story.
elaborate.zh: 证人拒绝详细阐述她的说法。

societal.s: Crime is often caused by societal problems like poverty.
societal.zh: 犯罪往往由贫困等社会问题引起。

extralegal.s: The group used extralegal means to punish the thief.
extralegal.zh: 那个团体用法外的手段惩罚了小偷。

nominal.s: He paid a nominal fee of one dollar for the land.
nominal.zh: 他为这块地支付了一美元的象征性费用。

omnipotent.s: The king acted as if he were omnipotent.
omnipotent.zh: 国王表现得好像自己是全能的。

expenditure.s: The city cut its expenditure on new roads.
expenditure.zh: 市政府削减了新道路的支出。

discovery.s: During discovery, each side must share its documents.
discovery.zh: 在披露阶段，双方都必须分享各自的文件。

recoup.s: The company sued to recoup its lost money.
recoup.zh: 公司提起诉讼以取回损失的钱。

estranged.s: He left nothing to his estranged daughter.
estranged.zh: 他没有给关系疏远的女儿留下任何东西。

disgruntlement.s: Long delays caused disgruntlement among people waiting in court.
disgruntlement.zh: 长时间的拖延引起了在法院等候的人们的不满。

burgeoning.s: The burgeoning city needed more courts.
burgeoning.zh: 这座迅速发展的城市需要更多的法院。

impetus.s: The accident gave new impetus to safety laws.
impetus.zh: 这起事故为安全立法提供了新的动力。

gamut.s: The judge has seen the whole gamut of crimes.
gamut.zh: 这位法官见识过从轻到重的全部犯罪类型。

mediator.s: A mediator helped the two neighbors reach an agreement.
mediator.zh: 一位调解人帮助两个邻居达成了协议。

posture.s: The company took a tough posture in the talks.
posture.zh: 公司在谈判中采取了强硬的姿态。

privacy.s: The police cannot read your letters; you have a right to privacy.
privacy.zh: 警察不能看你的信件，你享有隐私权。

contend.s: The lawyer contended that his client was at home that night.
contend.zh: 律师主张他的当事人那晚在家。

court-annexed.s: The judge sent them to court-annexed mediation before trial.
court-annexed.zh: 法官在审判前把他们送去进行法院附设的调解。

mini-trial.s: The two companies used a mini-trial to settle their dispute quickly.
mini-trial.zh: 两家公司通过诉讼外公断迅速解决了纠纷。

conspiracy.s: The three men were charged with conspiracy to rob a bank.
conspiracy.zh: 这三名男子被控共谋抢劫银行。

arbitrator.s: The arbitrator decided that the company must pay the workers.
arbitrator.zh: 仲裁员裁定公司必须向工人付款。

subpoena.s: The court sent her a subpoena to appear as a witness.
subpoena.zh: 法院向她发出传票，要求她出庭作证。

expeditious.s: Mediation is often an expeditious way to settle a dispute.
expeditious.zh: 调解往往是解决争议的迅速途径。

panacea.s: More prisons are not a panacea for crime.
panacea.zh: 多建监狱并不是解决犯罪的万灵药。

ad hoc.s: The city formed an ad hoc group to study the flood.
ad hoc.zh: 市政府成立了一个临时小组来研究洪水问题。

tout.s: The company touted its new product as the best.
tout.zh: 公司吹捧它的新产品是最好的。

negligence.s: The doctor's negligence caused the patient's death.
negligence.zh: 医生的过失导致了病人的死亡。

prospective.s: The prospective buyer looked at the house twice.
prospective.zh: 那位未来的买主看了两次房子。

contingency fee.s: With a contingency fee, the lawyer gets paid only if you win.
contingency fee.zh: 采用胜诉分成方式时，只有你胜诉律师才能拿到报酬。

convey.s: He conveyed the land to his son by deed.
convey.zh: 他通过契据把土地转让给了儿子。

confer.s: The law confers great power on the president.
confer.zh: 法律授予总统巨大的权力。

negotiation.s: After long negotiation, the two sides signed a deal.
negotiation.zh: 经过长时间的谈判，双方签署了协议。

wanton.s: The boys caused wanton damage to the school.
wanton.zh: 男孩们对学校造成了肆意的破坏。

reckless.s: He was fined for reckless driving.

reprehensible.s: Lying to a sick old woman for money is reprehensible.
reprehensible.zh: 为了钱欺骗生病的老太太是应受谴责的。

tabloid.s: The tabloid printed false stories about the judge.
tabloid.zh: 那家小报刊登了关于法官的虚假报道。

demurrer.s: The defendant filed a demurrer saying the complaint showed no legal wrong.
demurrer.zh: 被告提出诉求不充分抗辩，称起诉状没有表明任何法律上的过错。

default.s: He lost the case by default because he never came to court.
default.zh: 他因从未出庭而缺席败诉。

pleading.s: The complaint and the answer are both pleadings.
pleading.zh: 起诉状和答辩状都属于诉状。

juror.s: One juror fell asleep during the trial.
juror.zh: 一名陪审员在审判中睡着了。

candid.s: The witness gave a candid account of what she saw.
candid.zh: 证人坦率地讲述了她所看到的一切。

disclosure.s: The law requires full disclosure of the company's debts.
disclosure.zh: 法律要求全面披露公司的债务。

discoverable.s: Emails between the managers were discoverable in the lawsuit.
discoverable.zh: 经理们之间的电子邮件在这起诉讼中是可披露的。

tangible.s: A car is tangible property, but an idea is not.
tangible.zh: 汽车是有形财产，而一个想法不是。

custody.s: The suspect is now in police custody.

privilege.s: Senators have the privilege of free speech in Congress.
privilege.zh: 参议员在国会享有言论自由的特权。

admissible.s: The judge ruled that the letter was admissible as evidence.
admissible.zh: 法官裁定这封信作为证据是可采纳的。

deposition.s: Her deposition was taken in the lawyer's office.
deposition.zh: 她的书面证词是在律师办公室录取的。

stenographer.s: A stenographer typed every word the witness said.
stenographer.zh: 速记员把证人说的每一个字都打了下来。

verbatim.s: The newspaper printed a verbatim record of the speech.
verbatim.zh: 报纸刊登了这篇演讲的逐字记录。
