proportional.s: Your tax is proportional to your income.
proportional.zh: 你的税额与你的收入成比例。

false imprisonment.s: Locking a worker in a room can be false imprisonment.
false imprisonment.zh: 把工人锁在房间里可能构成非法拘禁。

culpable.s: Both drivers were culpable for the accident.
culpable.zh: 两名司机对这起事故都应受谴责。

tortious.s: Spreading lies about a rival is tortious conduct.
tortious.zh: 散布关于竞争对手的谎言是侵权行为。

apprehension.s: He waved a knife, causing her apprehension of harm.
apprehension.zh: 他挥舞着刀子，使她产生了会受伤害的恐惧。

infliction.s: The infliction of pain on prisoners is not allowed.
infliction.zh: 不允许对囚犯施加痛苦。

distress.s: The cruel phone calls caused her great distress.
distress.zh: 那些恶毒的电话给她造成了精神上的极度痛苦。

likeness.s: The company used her likeness in an ad without asking.
likeness.zh: 公司未经询问就在广告里使用了她的肖像。

false light.s: The story put the teacher in a false light.
false light.zh: 这篇报道错误地暴露了这位老师的隐私。

gauge.s: It is hard to gauge how much harm was done.
gauge.zh: 很难衡量造成了多大的损害。

renowned.s: She is a renowned lawyer in New York.
renowned.zh: 她是纽约一位著名的律师。

endorsement.s: The star earned millions from his shoe endorsement.
endorsement.zh: 这位明星靠给球鞋代言赚了几百万。

derogatory.s: He made derogatory remarks about his boss.
derogatory.zh: 他发表了贬损老板的言论。

defamatory.s: The newspaper printed a defamatory story about the mayor.
defamatory.zh: 报纸刊登了一篇关于市长的诽谤性报道。

slander.s: Telling everyone that Tom stole money was slander.
slander.zh: 告诉所有人汤姆偷了钱，这是口头诽谤。

ridicule.s: The false story exposed him to public ridicule.
ridicule.zh: 这篇虚假报道使他遭到公众的嘲笑。

esteem.s: The judge is held in high esteem.
esteem.zh: 这位法官受到高度尊重。

director.s: The directors of the company met to choose a new manager.
director.zh: 公司董事们开会选出新的经理。

perishable.s: Fruit is perishable, so it must be sold quickly.
perishable.zh: 水果容易腐烂，所以必须尽快卖掉。

disparage.s: The ad disparaged a rival company's products.
disparage.zh: 这则广告贬损了一家竞争对手公司的产品。

conversion.s: Selling a friend's car without permission is conversion.
conversion.zh: 未经允许卖掉朋友的汽车属于侵占。

hazardous.s: The truck was carrying hazardous chemicals.
hazardous.zh: 这辆卡车装载着危险化学品。

intimidate.s: The man tried to intimidate the witness.
intimidate.zh: 那个男人试图恐吓证人。

rejuvenate.s: The new park rejuvenated the old neighborhood.
rejuvenate.zh: 新公园使老社区恢复了活力。

notorious.s: The notorious gangster was finally caught.
notorious.zh: 这个臭名昭著的歹徒终于被抓住了。

cease.s: The court ordered the factory to cease work at night.
cease.zh: 法院命令工厂在夜间停止工作。

unauthorized.s: Unauthorized persons may not enter this room.
unauthorized.zh: 未经授权的人不得进入这个房间。

trademark.s: The company sued a rival for copying its trademark.
trademark.zh: 这家公司起诉一个竞争对手抄袭其商标。

espionage.s: The engineer was accused of industrial espionage.
espionage.zh: 这名工程师被指控从事商业间谍活动。

actionable.s: Calling someone a thief in public may be actionable.
actionable.zh: 当众称某人为小偷，可能会被提起诉讼。

entice.s: The rival company enticed the workers away with higher pay.
entice.zh: 竞争对手公司用更高的工资引诱工人离开。

retaliate.s: The boss retaliated by firing the worker who complained.
retaliate.zh: 老板以解雇投诉的工人作为报复。

whistle-blower.s: The whistle-blower told the press about the company's crimes.
whistle-blower.zh: 告发者向媒体揭发了公司的罪行。

at-will.s: As an at-will worker, he could be fired at any time.
at-will.zh: 作为任意雇佣的员工，他随时可能被解雇。

alienation.s: The alienation of land requires a written contract.
alienation.zh: 土地的转让需要书面合同。

aggression.s: Hitting someone first is an act of aggression.
aggression.zh: 先动手打人是一种侵犯行为。

synonymous.s: For many people, the name is synonymous with quality.
synonymous.zh: 对许多人来说，这个名字就是质量的同义词。

defective.s: The new car had defective brakes and crashed.
defective.zh: 这辆新车的刹车有缺陷，出了车祸。

bystander.s: A bystander was hurt when the two cars crashed.
bystander.zh: 两车相撞时，一名旁观者受了伤。

foreseeability.s: Foreseeability asks whether a careful person could expect the harm.
foreseeability.zh: 可预见性问的是一个谨慎的人能否预料到这种损害。

foreseeable.s: It was foreseeable that the icy steps would cause a fall.
foreseeable.zh: 结冰的台阶会让人摔倒，这是可预见的。

pharmaceutical.s: The pharmaceutical company tested the new drug for years.
pharmaceutical.zh: 这家制药公司对新药测试了好多年。

aggravated.s: He was charged with aggravated assault for using a knife.
aggravated.zh: 他因持刀伤人被控加重伤害罪。

warranty.s: The new TV comes with a two-year warranty.
warranty.zh: 这台新电视附带两年的质量担保。

vicarious.s: The company's vicarious responsibility came from its driver's mistake.
vicarious.zh: 公司的替代责任源于其司机的过错。

vicarious liability.s: Under vicarious liability, the company pays for its workers' mistakes.
vicarious liability.zh: 根据替代责任，公司要为员工的过错赔偿。

ransom.s: The kidnappers asked for a large ransom.

respondeat superior.s: Under respondeat superior, the bus company pays for its driver's accident.
respondeat superior.zh: 根据雇主负责原则，公交公司要为司机造成的事故赔偿。

allocation.s: The allocation of money to schools was unfair.
allocation.zh: 给学校的资金分配不公平。

offshoot.s: The new company is an offshoot of a big bank.
offshoot.zh: 这家新公司是一家大银行的分支。

immunity.s: Diplomats enjoy immunity from local laws.
immunity.zh: 外交官享有对当地法律的豁免。

absolve.s: The court absolved the driver of all blame.
absolve.zh: 法院解除了司机的全部责任。

resonate.s: His speech resonated with young voters.
resonate.zh: 他的演讲引起了年轻选民的共鸣。

burdensome.s: The new rules are too burdensome for small shops.
burdensome.zh: 新规定对小商店来说太繁重了。

autonomy.s: Patients have the autonomy to refuse treatment.
autonomy.zh: 病人有拒绝治疗的自主权。

avenge.s: He wanted to avenge his brother's death.

neutrality.s: A judge must keep strict neutrality in court.
neutrality.zh: 法官在法庭上必须保持严格的中立。

alienation of affections.s: She sued the other woman for alienation of affections.
alienation of affections.zh: 她以离间夫妻感情为由起诉了那个女人。

unjust enrichment.s: Keeping money paid to you by mistake is unjust enrichment.
unjust enrichment.zh: 留下别人错付给你的钱属于不当得利。

promisee.s: The promisee can sue if the promise is broken.
promisee.zh: 如果允诺被违背，受允诺人可以起诉。

venture.s: The two friends started a business venture together.
venture.zh: 两个朋友一起创办了一家企业。

quintessential.s: Tom is the quintessential small-town lawyer.
quintessential.zh: 汤姆是典型的小镇律师。

litigious.s: Americans are often called a litigious people.
litigious.zh: 美国人常被称为好讼的民族。

permeate.s: Fear permeated the whole town after the murder.
permeate.zh: 谋杀案发生后，恐惧弥漫了整个小镇。

term of art.s: In law, 'party' is a term of art meaning one side.
term of art.zh: 在法律上，“当事人”是一个特定术语，指案件的一方。

bilateral.s: A bilateral contract has promises on both sides.
bilateral.zh: 双方合同的双方都作出了允诺。

executory.s: The contract is still executory because nobody has paid yet.
executory.zh: 合同仍处于待履行状态，因为还没有人付款。

voidable.s: A contract signed by a child is voidable.
voidable.zh: 儿童签订的合同是可撤销的。

unenforceable.s: A promise to commit a crime is unenforceable.
unenforceable.zh: 犯罪的约定是不可强制执行的。

tender.s: The buyer tendered the full price, but the seller refused it.
tender.zh: 买方提供了全部价款，但卖方拒绝了。

nullity.s: A contract to sell drugs is a nullity.
nullity.zh: 买卖毒品的合同是一项无效的行为。

disaffirm.s: At eighteen, he disaffirmed the contract he signed as a boy.
disaffirm.zh: 十八岁时，他撤销了自己小时候签的合同。

rescind.s: The buyer rescinded the contract after finding the lie.
rescind.zh: 发现谎言后，买方解除了合同。

assent.s: Both sides must give their assent to the deal.
assent.zh: 双方都必须对这笔交易表示同意。

statute of frauds.s: Under the statute of frauds, a land sale must be in writing.
statute of frauds.zh: 根据防止欺诈法，土地买卖必须采用书面形式。

artificial person.s: A company is an artificial person that can own property.
artificial person.zh: 公司是可以拥有财产的法人。

legal fiction.s: Treating a company as a person is a legal fiction.
legal fiction.zh: 把公司当作人来对待是一种法律拟制。

shareholder.s: Each shareholder gets one vote for each share.
shareholder.zh: 股东每持有一股就有一票。

incapacity.s: His mental incapacity made the contract void.
incapacity.zh: 他精神上能力欠缺，使合同无效。

disclaimer.s: The ticket has a disclaimer about lost bags.
disclaimer.zh: 票上印有关于行李丢失的免责声明。

emancipation.s: After his emancipation at sixteen, he lived on his own.
emancipation.zh: 他十六岁从父母的控制下解放后就独立生活了。

transact.s: The two companies transact business by email.
transact.zh: 这两家公司通过电子邮件办理业务。

meeting of the minds.s: There was no meeting of the minds about the price.
meeting of the minds.zh: 双方在价格上没有达成合意。

construe.s: Courts construe unclear words against the person who wrote them.
construe.zh: 对于含糊的词语，法院会作出不利于起草者的解释。

binder.s: The binder protected her house until the real insurance papers came.
binder.zh: 在正式保险文件寄到之前，暂保单为她的房子提供保障。

casualty.s: The fire was a casualty, so the insurance company paid.
casualty.zh: 火灾属于意外事故，所以保险公司赔了钱。

lucrative.s: Selling medicine online became a lucrative business.
lucrative.zh: 网上卖药成了一门赚钱的生意。

offeree.s: The offeree has three days to accept the offer.
offeree.zh: 受要约人有三天时间接受要约。

offeror.s: The offeror can withdraw the offer before it is accepted.
offeror.zh: 要约人可以在要约被接受前撤回要约。

misrepresentation.s: The seller's misrepresentation about the car's age let the buyer cancel.
misrepresentation.zh: 卖方对车龄作了虚假陈述，因此买方可以取消交易。

debilitating.s: She suffers from a debilitating disease.
debilitating.zh: 她患有一种使人衰弱的疾病。

manipulate.s: The nephew manipulated the old man into signing the paper.
manipulate.zh: 侄子操纵老人签署了那份文件。

gift.s: The ring was a gift, so she need not return it.
gift.zh: 戒指是赠与物，所以她不必归还。

beneficiary.s: His daughter is the beneficiary of his life insurance.
beneficiary.zh: 他的女儿是他人寿保险的受益人。

infirmity.s: Because of his infirmity, the old man could not sign his name.
infirmity.zh: 由于身体虚弱，老人无法签自己的名字。

trustee.s: The trustee manages the money for the children.
trustee.zh: 受托人为孩子们管理这笔钱。

power of attorney.s: She gave her son power of attorney to sign checks for her.
power of attorney.zh: 她给了儿子授权书，让他替她签支票。

induce.s: He induced her to sign by lying about the price.
induce.zh: 他谎报价格，诱使她签了字。

reputable.s: Always buy a car from a reputable dealer.
reputable.zh: 一定要从声誉好的经销商那里买车。

bona fide.s: A bona fide buyer did not know the goods were stolen.
bona fide.zh: 善意的买方不知道货物是偷来的。

afoul.s: The new plan ran afoul of city rules.
afoul.zh: 新计划与城市规定相抵触。

takeover.s: The bank announced its takeover of a smaller bank.
takeover.zh: 这家银行宣布接管一家较小的银行。

invitation to treat.s: A price tag in a shop window is an invitation to treat.
invitation to treat.zh: 商店橱窗里的价格标签是要约邀请。

lapse.s: The offer lapsed because no one answered within a week.
lapse.zh: 这一要约失效了，因为一周内没有人答复。

retraction.s: The newspaper printed a retraction of the false story.
retraction.zh: 报纸就这篇虚假报道刊登了公开赔礼道歉的声明。

obligor.s: The obligor must pay the money by June.
obligor.zh: 债务人必须在六月前付款。

assignable.s: This contract is not assignable to another company.
assignable.zh: 这份合同不可转让给另一家公司。

nonperformance.s: The seller's nonperformance cost the buyer a lot of money.
nonperformance.zh: 卖方未履行合同，让买方损失了很多钱。

contravene.s: The new rule contravenes the Constitution.

repudiation.s: His repudiation of the contract came one week before delivery.
repudiation.zh: 他在交货前一周拒绝履行合同。

impossibility.s: Impossibility applies when a fire destroys the house to be sold.
impossibility.zh: 当待售的房子被大火烧毁时，适用履行不能。

repudiate.s: The builder repudiated the contract and walked away.
repudiate.zh: 建筑商拒绝履行合同，一走了之。

impunity.s: The rich man broke the law with impunity.
impunity.zh: 这个富人违法，却得以免除惩罚。

inadvertent.s: The error was inadvertent, not deliberate.
inadvertent.zh: 这个错误是无意的，而不是故意的。

liquidated damages.s: The contract sets liquidated damages of 100 dollars per day.
liquidated damages.zh: 合同规定了每天一百美元的约定违约金。

predetermine.s: The price was predetermined in the contract.
predetermine.zh: 价格在合同中已经预先确定。

contemplation.s: The loss was within the contemplation of both sides.
contemplation.zh: 这种损失在双方的期待之中。

mitigate.s: He must find another buyer to mitigate his losses.
mitigate.zh: 他必须找到另一个买家来减轻损失。

procrastination.s: His procrastination caused him to miss the deadline.
procrastination.zh: 他的拖延使他错过了截止日期。

humiliation.s: Being fired in front of everyone caused him great humiliation.
humiliation.zh: 当众被解雇让他感到极大的屈辱。

promissory estoppel.s: Promissory estoppel protects people who reasonably rely on a promise.
promissory estoppel.zh: 允诺性不容否定原则保护合理信赖允诺的人。

gratuitous.s: His promise was gratuitous because he got nothing in return.
gratuitous.zh: 他的允诺是单方受益的，因为他没有得到任何回报。

promisor.s: The promisor must keep his word.

lien.s: The garage kept a lien on the car until Tom paid.
lien.zh: 在汤姆付钱之前，修车厂对这辆车享有留置权。

prenuptial.s: They signed a prenuptial agreement before the wedding.
prenuptial.zh: 他们在婚礼前签署了婚前协议。

surety.s: His father acted as surety for the bank loan.
surety.zh: 他父亲为这笔银行贷款充当保证人。

parol evidence rule.s: The parol evidence rule limits proof of earlier spoken deals.
parol evidence rule.zh: 口头证据规则限制对先前口头约定的证明。

indefiniteness.s: The deal failed for indefiniteness because no price was set.
indefiniteness.zh: 由于没有确定价格，这笔交易因内容不确切而失败。

interminable.s: The lawyer gave an interminable speech that bored everyone.
interminable.zh: 律师发表了冗长不休的讲话，让所有人都很厌烦。

negotiable.s: A check is a negotiable paper that can pass to others.
negotiable.zh: 支票是一种可以转给他人的可流通票据。

instrument.s: A check is the most common kind of instrument used in trade.
instrument.zh: 支票是贸易中最常用的一种票据。

letter of credit.s: The bank issued a letter of credit to the seller.
letter of credit.zh: 银行向卖方开出了信用证。

bill of lading.s: The ship's captain signed the bill of lading for the goods.
bill of lading.zh: 船长签署了这批货物的提单。

secured transaction.s: A car loan is a secured transaction backed by the car.
secured transaction.zh: 汽车贷款是一种以汽车作担保的担保交易。

personal property.s: Books, cars and furniture are personal property.
personal property.zh: 书籍、汽车和家具都是动产。

repossess.s: The bank repossessed his car when he stopped paying.
repossess.zh: 他停止还款后，银行收回了他的车。

thing in action.s: A right to collect a debt is a thing in action.
thing in action.zh: 收取债务的权利是一种权利动产。

counteroffer.s: The buyer made a counteroffer at a lower price.
counteroffer.zh: 买方以更低的价格提出了反要约。

merchantable.s: Goods must be merchantable, meaning fit for normal use.
merchantable.zh: 货物必须是适销的，也就是适合正常使用。

fungible.s: Rice is fungible, since one bag is as good as another.
fungible.zh: 大米是可替代的，因为一袋和另一袋一样好。

solvent.s: The company is solvent and can pay all its debts.
solvent.zh: 这家公司有偿债能力，可以偿还所有债务。

insolvent.s: The bank became insolvent and could not pay its customers.
insolvent.zh: 这家银行无力偿债，无法向客户付款。

incidental.s: The buyer paid incidental costs, such as storing the goods.
incidental.zh: 买方支付了附带费用，比如存放货物的费用。

consequential.s: Lost profits are a kind of consequential loss.
consequential.zh: 利润损失是一种间接损失。

conglomeration.s: The city is a conglomeration of small towns.
conglomeration.zh: 这座城市是由许多小镇组成的混合体。

usury.s: Charging fifty percent interest is usury.
usury.zh: 收取百分之五十的利息就是高利贷。

nurture.s: The care and nurture of a child belong to the parents.
nurture.zh: 照顾和养育孩子首先是父母的事。

entertain.s: The court refused to entertain the case.

oversight.s: Congress has oversight of the new agency.
oversight.zh: 国会对这个新机构有监督权。

dilution.s: Using the famous name on cheap goods causes dilution of the brand.
dilution.zh: 在廉价商品上使用这个著名名称会淡化该品牌。

deceptive.s: The ad was deceptive because the price was false.
deceptive.zh: 这则广告是欺诈性的，因为价格是假的。

bait and switch.s: In bait and switch, the cheap TV is always 'sold out'.
bait and switch.zh: 在上钩调包诱售法中，那台便宜的电视总是“卖光了”。

conjunction.s: The police worked in conjunction with the school.
conjunction.zh: 警方与学校联合开展工作。

co-signer.s: His father was the co-signer on his car loan.
co-signer.zh: 他的父亲是他汽车贷款的连署人。

issuer.s: The issuer of the credit card is a large bank.
issuer.zh: 这张信用卡的发行人是一家大银行。

unconscionable.s: Charging a poor man ten times the price was unconscionable.
unconscionable.zh: 向一个穷人收取十倍的价格是显失公平的。

unconscionability.s: The buyer argued unconscionability because the terms were extremely unfair.
unconscionability.zh: 买方以条款极不公平为由主张显失公平。

exorbitant.s: The hotel charged an exorbitant price for water.
exorbitant.zh: 酒店对饮用水收取过高的价格。

lopsided.s: The deal was lopsided in favor of the seller.
lopsided.zh: 这笔交易不平衡，偏向卖方。

vibrant.s: The city has a vibrant economy.
vibrant.zh: 这座城市的经济充满活力。

proprietorship.s: Tom runs his small shop as a sole proprietorship.
proprietorship.zh: 汤姆以独资企业的形式经营他的小店。

artisan.s: The artisan made the table by hand.
artisan.zh: 这位工匠手工制作了这张桌子。

proprietor.s: The proprietor of the restaurant greeted every guest.
proprietor.zh: 餐馆的业主迎接每一位客人。

partnership.s: The two doctors formed a partnership to open a clinic.
partnership.zh: 两位医生合伙开了一家诊所。

salient.s: The lawyer listed the salient facts of the case.
salient.zh: 律师列出了本案的显著事实。

partner.s: Each partner shares the profits of the firm.
partner.zh: 每个合伙人都分享公司的利润。

dissolution.s: After the dissolution of the company, the workers lost their jobs.
dissolution.zh: 公司解散后，工人们失业了。

silent partner.s: A silent partner gives money but does not run the business.
silent partner.zh: 隐名合伙人出钱，但不经营业务。

joint.s: The couple opened a joint bank account.
joint.zh: 这对夫妻开了一个共同的银行账户。

advantageous.s: The new rule is advantageous to small companies.

stockholder.s: Every stockholder received a letter about the meeting.
stockholder.zh: 每位股东都收到了一封关于会议的信。

conglomerate.s: The huge conglomerate owns banks, hotels and TV stations.
conglomerate.zh: 这个庞大的联合大企业拥有银行、酒店和电视台。

closely held corporation.s: A closely held corporation has only a few owners, often a family.
closely held corporation.zh: 封闭型公司只有少数几个所有者，往往是一个家族。

pro rata.s: The profits were shared pro rata among the owners.
pro rata.zh: 利润在所有者之间按比例分配。

broker.s: She hired a broker to buy shares for her.
broker.zh: 她雇了一名经纪人替她买股票。

skyrocket.s: House prices skyrocketed after the new subway opened.
skyrocket.zh: 新地铁开通后，房价猛涨。

conversely.s: Rich people pay more tax; conversely, poor people pay less.
conversely.zh: 富人交更多的税；相反地，穷人交得更少。

dividend.s: The company paid each stockholder a dividend of two dollars.
dividend.zh: 公司向每位股东支付了两美元的股息。

preferred stock.s: Owners of preferred stock get their dividends first.
preferred stock.zh: 优先股的持有人先拿到股息。

sinecure.s: His job was a sinecure with high pay and no work.
sinecure.zh: 他的工作是一个高薪而无事可做的挂名职务。

mismanagement.s: The company failed because of mismanagement.
mismanagement.zh: 这家公司因管理不当而倒闭。

obstruction.s: He was charged with obstruction for hiding the evidence.
obstruction.zh: 他因隐藏证据被控妨碍司法。

audit.s: The tax office ordered an audit of the company's books.
audit.zh: 税务部门下令对公司的账目进行审计。

indemnity.s: The insurance company paid an indemnity for the fire damage.
indemnity.zh: 保险公司为火灾损失支付了补偿。

unswerving.s: The lawyer showed unswerving loyalty to her client.
unswerving.zh: 律师对她的当事人表现出坚定不移的忠诚。

compact.s: The two states signed a compact to share the river water.
compact.zh: 两个州签署了一项共享河水的协定。

pierce the corporate veil.s: The court may pierce the corporate veil if the owner cheats.
pierce the corporate veil.zh: 如果所有者欺诈，法院可以揭穿公司面纱。

discernible.s: There was no discernible reason for the attack.
discernible.zh: 这次攻击没有可辨别的理由。

appurtenance.s: The garage is an appurtenance of the house.
appurtenance.zh: 车库是这栋房子的附属物。

thereto.s: Please read the contract and the list attached thereto.
thereto.zh: 请阅读合同以及附随于此的清单。

possessory.s: A tenant has a possessory right to the apartment.
possessory.zh: 租户对公寓享有占有的权利。

condominium.s: She bought a condominium on the tenth floor.
condominium.zh: 她在十楼买了一套分户产权公寓。

affix.s: A light affixed to the wall becomes part of the house.
affix.zh: 固定在墙上的灯就成了房子的一部分。

personalty.s: Cars and jewelry are personalty, not land.
personalty.zh: 汽车和珠宝是动产，而不是土地。

sever.s: Cutting down the tree severs it from the land.
sever.zh: 砍倒树木就把它与土地分离了。

goodwill.s: When he sold the shop, the buyer paid extra for its goodwill.
goodwill.zh: 他出售商店时，买方为商店的商誉额外付了钱。

promissory note.s: Tom signed a promissory note to repay the loan in a year.
promissory note.zh: 汤姆签了一张本票，承诺一年内还清贷款。

copyright.s: The author owns the copyright to her book.
copyright.zh: 作者拥有她这本书的版权。

dispose.s: An owner may dispose of his land as he wishes.
dispose.zh: 所有人可以按自己的意愿处分他的土地。

fee simple.s: Owning land in fee simple is the fullest form of ownership.
fee simple.zh: 以非限嗣继承地产权拥有土地是最完整的所有权形式。

heir.s: His son is the only heir to the farm.
heir.zh: 他的儿子是农场唯一的法定继承人。

nonfreehold.s: A one-year lease is a nonfreehold right to use land.
nonfreehold.zh: 一年期租约是一种非自由保有的土地使用权。

mired.s: The project was mired in legal problems.
mired.zh: 这个项目陷入了法律问题。

communal.s: The village has a communal well for everyone.
communal.zh: 村里有一口供大家使用的公共水井。

conquest.s: After the Norman conquest, the king owned all the land.
conquest.zh: 诺曼征服之后，国王拥有全部土地。

succession.s: The law sets the order of succession to a dead person's property.
succession.zh: 法律规定了死者财产的继承顺序。

grantee.s: The grantee received the land from her father.
grantee.zh: 受让人从她父亲那里获得了这块土地。

reservation.s: He sold the land with a reservation of the right to fish.
reservation.zh: 他出售了土地，但保留了钓鱼的权利。

occupancy.s: The new building is not ready for occupancy yet.
occupancy.zh: 这栋新楼还不能投入占用。

subordination.s: The subordination of states to federal law is clear.
subordination.zh: 各州从属于联邦法律，这一点很清楚。

seisin.s: In old England, seisin meant lawful possession of land.
seisin.zh: 在古代英格兰，这种占有指的是自由人对土地的合法占有。

tenancy.s: His tenancy of the apartment ends in June.
tenancy.zh: 他对这套公寓的租赁于六月到期。

bewildering.s: The rules of old land law are bewildering to students.
bewildering.zh: 古老的土地法规则让学生们感到困惑。

freehold.s: He owns the freehold of the house and the land.
freehold.zh: 他拥有这栋房子及其土地的自由保有地产权。

fee tail.s: A fee tail passed land only to the owner's children.
fee tail.zh: 限嗣继承地产权只把土地传给所有人的子女。

life estate.s: She has a life estate in the house until she dies.
life estate.zh: 她对这栋房子享有终身地产权，直到她去世为止。

durable.s: The table is made of durable wood.
durable.zh: 这张桌子是用持久耐用的木材做的。

connote.s: The word 'home' connotes comfort and safety.
connote.zh: “家”这个词意味着舒适和安全。

divestment.s: The court ordered the divestment of his rights to the land.
divestment.zh: 法院下令缩减他对这块土地的权利。

grantor.s: The grantor gave the land to his nephew as a gift.
grantor.zh: 让与人把土地作为礼物送给了侄子。

primogeniture.s: Under primogeniture, the oldest son got all the land.
primogeniture.zh: 根据长子继承权，长子得到全部土地。

intact.s: The old house survived the storm intact.
intact.zh: 老房子经历风暴后仍然完整。

ravage.s: The town never recovered from the ravages of war.
ravage.zh: 这个小镇再也没有从战争的破坏中恢复过来。

dissolute.s: The dissolute son wasted all his father's money.
dissolute.zh: 这个放荡的儿子挥霍光了父亲所有的钱。

lineal.s: A grandson is a lineal relative of his grandfather.
lineal.zh: 孙子是祖父的直系亲属。

descent.s: The farm passed by descent from father to son.
descent.zh: 农场依照血统继承制从父亲传给了儿子。

egalitarian.s: The new law created a more egalitarian society.
egalitarian.zh: 新法律创造了一个更加平等主义的社会。

estate pur autre vie.s: Tom holds an estate pur autre vie, lasting for his aunt's life.
estate pur autre vie.zh: 汤姆享有一项他人生存期保有的地产，持续到他姑姑去世为止。

peruse.s: Please peruse the contract before you sign it.
peruse.zh: 签合同之前请细读一遍。

cloud on title.s: An old unpaid debt created a cloud on title to the house.
cloud on title.zh: 一笔未还的旧债造成了这栋房子的权利瑕疵。

realtor.s: The realtor showed us three houses on Sunday.
realtor.zh: 房地产经纪人星期天带我们看了三套房子。

leasehold.s: He owns a leasehold on the shop for ten years.
leasehold.zh: 他拥有这家店铺十年的租赁保有权。

reversion.s: When the lease ends, the owner has a reversion of the land.
reversion.zh: 租约结束时，所有人享有土地的归复权。

estate for years.s: A two-year lease creates an estate for years.
estate for years.zh: 一份两年期租约设立了一项定期地产权。

lessor.s: The lessor must repair the roof.

lessee.s: The lessee pays rent on the first of each month.
lessee.zh: 承租人每月一号支付租金。

quiet enjoyment.s: The noisy landlord broke the tenant's right to quiet enjoyment.
quiet enjoyment.zh: 吵闹的房东侵犯了租户安静享用的权利。

sublease.s: Mary subleased her apartment to a student for the summer.
sublease.zh: 玛丽在夏天把公寓转租给了一个学生。

habitable.s: The landlord must keep the apartment habitable.
habitable.zh: 房东必须保持公寓适于居住。

evict.s: The landlord evicted the tenant for not paying rent.
evict.zh: 房东因租户不交租金而将其驱逐。

community property.s: In some states, a couple's income is community property.
community property.zh: 在一些州，夫妻的收入属于夫妻共同财产。

undivided.s: Each sister owns an undivided half of the house.
undivided.zh: 姐妹俩各自拥有这栋房子未分割的一半份额。

cotenancy.s: The three brothers hold the farm in cotenancy.

tenancy in common.s: In a tenancy in common, each owner can sell his share.
tenancy in common.zh: 在普通共有中，每个共有人都可以出售自己的份额。

concurrently.s: He served two prison terms concurrently.

thereunder.s: The law and the rules made thereunder apply to all banks.
thereunder.zh: 这项法律以及据此制定的规则适用于所有银行。

joint tenancy.s: Under joint tenancy, the house goes to the living owner.
joint tenancy.zh: 在共同保有下，房子归仍在世的共同保有人所有。

survivorship.s: Because of survivorship, the wife got the whole house.
survivorship.zh: 由于生存者权利，妻子得到了整栋房子。

co-owner.s: Each co-owner must agree before the land is sold.
co-owner.zh: 出售土地前，每个共有人都必须同意。

easement.s: The neighbor has an easement to cross my land.
easement.zh: 邻居享有穿过我土地的地役权。

right-of-way.s: The farmer gave the town a right-of-way for a road.
right-of-way.zh: 农民给了镇上修路的通行权。

subsurface.s: The owner also has rights to the subsurface oil.
subsurface.zh: 所有人对地表下的石油也享有权利。

severance.s: The severance of the trees from the land made them personal property.
severance.zh: 树木与土地分离后，就成了动产。

subterranean.s: The miners worked in subterranean tunnels.
subterranean.zh: 矿工们在地下隧道里工作。

blighted.s: The city plans to rebuild the blighted area.
blighted.zh: 该市计划重建这个有损市容的地区。

specification.s: The house was built to the buyer's specifications.
specification.zh: 房子是按照买方的说明书建造的。

nonconforming.s: The old shop is a nonconforming use in a residential area.
nonconforming.zh: 这家老店在住宅区内属于不规范用途。

behest.s: He sold the house at his wife's behest.
behest.zh: 他应妻子的要求卖掉了房子。

degradation.s: Pollution caused the degradation of the land.
degradation.zh: 污染导致了土地质量的下降。

sprawl.s: Urban sprawl has eaten up farmland near the city.
sprawl.zh: 城市的无序扩张吞噬了城市附近的农田。

breadth.s: The breadth of the new law surprised many people.
breadth.zh: 新法律的广度令许多人吃惊。

disrepair.s: The old house fell into disrepair after the owner died.
disrepair.zh: 主人去世后，老房子年久失修。

guaranty.s: The bank asked for a personal guaranty from the owner.
guaranty.zh: 银行要求所有人提供个人保证。

inclusive.s: The public good is a broad and inclusive idea.
inclusive.zh: 公共利益是一个宽泛、包含面广的概念。

foreclosure.s: After missing many payments, they lost their house to foreclosure.
foreclosure.zh: 他们多次没有还款，房子的回赎权被终止了。

adverse possession.s: After twenty years of use, he got the land by adverse possession.
adverse possession.zh: 使用二十年后，他通过时效占有取得了这块土地。

wrest.s: The rebels tried to wrest control from the king.
wrest.zh: 叛乱者试图从国王手中夺取控制权。

color of title.s: He had color of title because of a paper that looked valid.
color of title.zh: 由于有一份看似有效的文件，他拥有表面上的所有权。

quitclaim.s: She signed a quitclaim, giving up any right to the land.
quitclaim.zh: 她签了一份放弃权利的文书，放弃了对土地的任何权利。

encumbrance.s: A mortgage is a common encumbrance on a house.
encumbrance.zh: 抵押是房屋上常见的财产负担。

wary.s: Be wary of anyone who offers a deal that is too good.
wary.zh: 要警惕那些提供好得离谱的交易的人。

marketable.s: The buyer wants marketable title with no problems.
marketable.zh: 买方想要一份毫无瑕疵的产权。

security interest.s: The bank keeps a security interest in the car he bought.
security interest.zh: 银行对他买的汽车保有担保利益。

foreclose.s: The bank foreclosed on the house after a year of missed payments.
foreclose.zh: 一年没有还款后，银行终止了房主对房子的回赎权。

remit.s: Please remit the payment by the end of the month.

contingent.s: The sale is contingent on the bank giving a loan.
contingent.zh: 这笔买卖以银行发放贷款为条件。

outright.s: He became the outright owner of the house.
outright.zh: 他成了这栋房子的完全所有人。

transferability.s: Easy transferability makes stocks popular with buyers.
transferability.zh: 很强的可转让性使股票受到买家欢迎。

abhor.s: Most people abhor cruelty to children.
abhor.zh: 大多数人憎恶虐待儿童的行为。

testate.s: She died testate, leaving a clear will.
testate.zh: 她去世时留有遗嘱，而且是一份清楚的遗嘱。

intestate.s: He died intestate, so state law divided his property.
intestate.zh: 他去世时未立遗嘱，所以由州法律分配他的财产。

intestacy.s: In cases of intestacy, the money goes to the closest relatives.
intestacy.zh: 在无遗嘱死亡的情况下，钱归最近的亲属。

testator.s: The testator left his house to his nurse.
testator.zh: 这个已立遗嘱的男人把房子留给了他的护士。

outgrowth.s: The new law was an outgrowth of public anger.
outgrowth.zh: 新法律是公众愤怒的产物。

testamentary.s: She made a testamentary gift of her books to the school.
testamentary.zh: 她通过遗嘱把自己的书赠给了学校。

disburse.s: The bank will disburse the loan next week.
disburse.zh: 银行将于下周支付这笔贷款。

consanguinity.s: Cousins are related by consanguinity, sharing the same grandparents.
consanguinity.zh: 堂兄弟之间有血亲关系，他们有共同的祖父母。

affinity.s: Your wife's brother is related to you by affinity.
affinity.zh: 你妻子的兄弟和你是姻亲关系。

predecease.s: If his son predeceases him, the money goes to his grandson.
predecease.zh: 如果他的儿子在他之前死亡，钱就归他的孙子。

escheat.s: With no heirs, his property went to the state by escheat.
escheat.zh: 由于没有继承人，他的财产因土地复归而归国家所有。

guardianship.s: The court gave the aunt guardianship of the two children.
guardianship.zh: 法院把两个孩子的监护权交给了姑姑。

disreputable.s: He lost money to a disreputable car dealer.
disreputable.zh: 他在一个声名狼藉的汽车经销商那里赔了钱。

holographic.s: She wrote a holographic will by hand on one page.
holographic.zh: 她在一页纸上亲笔书写了一份遗嘱。

nuncupative.s: The dying soldier made a nuncupative will in front of two friends.
nuncupative.zh: 这位垂死的士兵当着两个朋友的面立下了口述遗嘱。

fleeting.s: He had only a fleeting chance to escape.
fleeting.zh: 他只有一个短暂的逃跑机会。

pivotal.s: The witness played a pivotal role in the trial.
pivotal.zh: 这名证人在审判中起了关键作用。

disinherit.s: The angry father disinherited his son.
disinherit.zh: 愤怒的父亲剥夺了儿子的继承权。

axiomatic.s: It is axiomatic that a judge must be fair.
axiomatic.zh: 法官必须公正，这是不言自明的。

codicil.s: He added a codicil to his will to include his new grandson.
codicil.zh: 他给遗嘱加了一份遗嘱补正书，把刚出生的孙子也写了进去。

annulment.s: After the annulment, it was as if the marriage never happened.
annulment.zh: 婚姻被宣告无效后，就好像这段婚姻从未存在过。

living will.s: Her living will refuses machines that keep her alive.
living will.zh: 她的安乐死志愿书拒绝用机器维持她的生命。

incapacitated.s: After the accident, he was incapacitated and could not manage money.
incapacitated.zh: 事故之后，他丧失了行为能力，无法管理钱财。

philanthropist.s: The philanthropist gave millions to build schools.
philanthropist.zh: 这位慈善家捐了几百万建学校。

eclipse.s: The new star soon eclipsed the older actors.
eclipse.zh: 这位新星很快使老演员们黯然失色。

residuary.s: The residuary part of his estate went to his church.
residuary.zh: 他剩余的遗产归了他的教会。

bequest.s: She left a bequest of ten thousand dollars to the library.
bequest.zh: 她给图书馆留下了一万美元的遗赠。

meritorious.s: The soldier received a medal for meritorious service.
meritorious.zh: 这名士兵因值得称赞的服役表现获得了奖章。

enmity.s: There was deep enmity between the two families.
enmity.zh: 两家人之间有很深的敌意。

trustor.s: The trustor put his house into a trust for his kids.
trustor.zh: 信托人把房子放进信托，留给孩子们。

settlor.s: The settlor created the trust to pay for her grandson's school.
settlor.zh: 信托创立人设立了这个信托，用来支付孙子的学费。

inter vivos.s: He made an inter vivos gift of his farm to his son.
inter vivos.zh: 他把农场作为生存者之间的赠与送给了儿子。

spendthrift.s: His son is a spendthrift who wastes every dollar.
spendthrift.zh: 他的儿子是个挥霍者，每一块钱都乱花。

rule against perpetuities.s: The rule against perpetuities stops owners from controlling land forever.
rule against perpetuities.zh: 禁止永久权规则阻止所有人永远控制土地。

diligence.s: The trustee must manage the money with care and diligence.
diligence.zh: 受托人必须谨慎勤勉地管理这笔钱。

fiduciary.s: As a fiduciary, the trustee must act in the family's interest.
fiduciary.zh: 作为受信人，受托人必须为这家人的利益行事。

donee.s: The donee received the car as a gift.
donee.zh: 受赠人收到了这辆作为礼物的汽车。

intellectual property.s: Songs and inventions are forms of intellectual property.
intellectual property.zh: 歌曲和发明都是知识产权的形式。

enshrine.s: Free speech is enshrined in the Constitution.
enshrine.zh: 言论自由被庄严载入宪法。

enumerate.s: The Constitution enumerates the powers of Congress.
enumerate.zh: 宪法列举了国会的各项权力。

plagiarism.s: The student was punished for plagiarism in his paper.
plagiarism.zh: 这个学生因论文剽窃而受到处罚。

guild.s: In the Middle Ages, each trade had its own guild.
guild.zh: 在中世纪，每个行业都有自己的行会。

ingrained.s: The habit of saving money is deeply ingrained in her.
ingrained.zh: 存钱的习惯在她身上根深蒂固。

patentee.s: The patentee can stop others from copying the invention.
patentee.zh: 专利权人可以阻止他人复制这项发明。

prolific.s: Edison was a prolific inventor with over a thousand patents.
prolific.zh: 爱迪生是一位多产的发明家，拥有一千多项专利。

hindrance.s: The heavy bag was a hindrance when he ran.
hindrance.zh: 他跑步时，沉重的包成了阻碍。

originality.s: Copyright requires some originality in the work.
originality.zh: 版权要求作品具有一定的独创性。

utility.s: To get a patent, an invention must show utility.
utility.zh: 要获得专利，一项发明必须具有实用性。

prior art.s: The patent was refused because of prior art from 1990.
prior art.zh: 由于存在一九九零年的现有技术，这项专利申请被拒绝了。

non-obviousness.s: Non-obviousness means the invention is not an easy next step.
non-obviousness.zh: 非显而易见性是指这项发明不是轻易就能想到的下一步。

patentable.s: A new kind of machine is patentable, but an idea is not.
patentable.zh: 一种新型机器是可授予专利的，但一个想法不是。

ornamental.s: The garden has many ornamental plants.
ornamental.zh: 花园里有许多装饰性植物。

signatory.s: Each signatory agreed to protect copyrights.
signatory.zh: 每个签字国都同意保护版权。

intermittent.s: There was intermittent rain all day.
intermittent.zh: 一整天都在下间歇性的雨。

derivative.s: A movie based on a book is a derivative work.
derivative.zh: 根据书改编的电影是演绎作品。

fixation.s: A song gets copyright after fixation on paper or tape.
fixation.zh: 歌曲固定在纸上或磁带上之后才获得版权。

work for hire.s: As a work for hire, the article belongs to the newspaper.
work for hire.zh: 作为雇佣作品，这篇文章归报社所有。

retroactively.s: The new tax was applied retroactively to last year.
retroactively.zh: 新税被溯及既往地适用于去年。

fair use.s: Quoting a few lines for a book review is fair use.
fair use.zh: 为写书评引用几行文字属于合理使用。

circumvention.s: The circumvention of copy protection is illegal.
circumvention.zh: 规避防复制措施是违法的。

misappropriation.s: The worker's misappropriation of company secrets led to a lawsuit.
misappropriation.zh: 这名员工盗用公司机密，引发了一场诉讼。

penchant.s: He has a penchant for expensive cars.

franchise.s: She bought a fast-food franchise in her hometown.
franchise.zh: 她在家乡买下了一家快餐店的特许权。

distinctive.s: The company's logo has a distinctive red color.
distinctive.zh: 这家公司的标志有独特的红色。

right of publicity.s: Using a star's face in an ad violates her right of publicity.
right of publicity.zh: 在广告中使用明星的脸侵犯了她的公开权。

injunctive.s: The court gave injunctive orders to stop the illegal copies.
injunctive.zh: 法院发布了禁制令，制止非法复制。

depict.s: The painting depicts a farm in winter.
depict.zh: 这幅画描绘了冬天的一个农场。

entangled.s: The bird became entangled in the fishing net.

auspices.s: The talks were held under the auspices of the United Nations.
auspices.zh: 会谈在联合国的主持下举行。

reverberation.s: The court's decision had reverberations across the country.
reverberation.zh: 法院的判决在全国引起了反响。

vow.s: The couple made their wedding vows in a small church.
vow.zh: 这对夫妇在一座小教堂里许下了婚礼誓言。

carte blanche.s: The boss gave her carte blanche to hire new workers.
carte blanche.zh: 老板给予她招聘新员工的无限制授权。

hoard.s: People hoarded food before the storm.
hoard.zh: 暴风雨来临前，人们囤积食物。

futile.s: His attempts to escape were futile.
futile.zh: 他的逃跑尝试都是徒劳的。

outmoded.s: The old law is outmoded and needs to change.
outmoded.zh: 这条旧法律已经过时，需要修改。

onslaught.s: The new law faced an onslaught of criticism.
onslaught.zh: 新法律遭到了一轮猛烈的批评。

grudgingly.s: He grudgingly agreed to pay the fine.

livelihood.s: The fire destroyed the farmer's livelihood.
livelihood.zh: 这场火灾毁掉了农民的生计。

impinge.s: The new rule impinges on our freedom of speech.
impinge.zh: 新规定侵犯了我们的言论自由。

immeasurable.s: The war caused immeasurable harm to the country.
immeasurable.zh: 战争给这个国家造成了不可估量的伤害。

paternity.s: A blood test proved his paternity of the child.
paternity.zh: 血液检测证明了他是这个孩子的父亲。

spousal.s: The law protects women from spousal abuse.
spousal.zh: 法律保护妇女免受配偶的虐待。

precursor.s: The old club was the precursor of the modern union.
precursor.zh: 那个老俱乐部是现代工会的前身。

no-fault.s: Under no-fault divorce, nobody has to prove the other did wrong.
no-fault.zh: 在无过错离婚制度下，任何一方都不必证明对方有错。

justiciable.s: The court said the dispute was not justiciable.
justiciable.zh: 法院说这一争议不可受法院裁判。

indissoluble.s: The church once saw marriage as indissoluble.
indissoluble.zh: 教会曾经认为婚姻是不可解除的。

countervailing.s: The judge weighed the countervailing interests of both sides.
countervailing.zh: 法官权衡了双方对立的利益。

amicably.s: The couple settled their divorce amicably.
amicably.zh: 这对夫妻友好地解决了离婚问题。

impute.s: The court imputed the driver's fault to his employer.
impute.zh: 法院把司机的过错归责于他的雇主。

obliterate.s: The flood obliterated the small village.
obliterate.zh: 洪水把这个小村庄完全抹去了。

breakdown.s: The breakdown of their marriage led to divorce.
breakdown.zh: 他们婚姻的破裂导致了离婚。

uncontroverted.s: The facts of the case were uncontroverted.
uncontroverted.zh: 本案的事实是无争议的。

public policy.s: A contract to commit a crime is against public policy.
public policy.zh: 约定犯罪的合同违反公共政策。

commingle.s: The trustee must not commingle trust money with his own.
commingle.zh: 受托人不得把信托资金与自己的钱混合在一起。

cohabitation.s: Their cohabitation lasted ten years before they married.
cohabitation.zh: 他们在结婚前同居了十年。

intrusive.s: The questions about her private life were too intrusive.
intrusive.zh: 关于她私生活的问题太具侵扰性了。

common law marriage.s: They never had a wedding but had a common law marriage.
common law marriage.zh: 他们从未举行婚礼，但形成了普通法婚姻。

puberty.s: Children's bodies change quickly during puberty.
puberty.zh: 孩子的身体在青春期变化很快。

unemancipated.s: An unemancipated child still lives under his parents' control.
unemancipated.zh: 未脱离监护的孩子仍受父母管教。

monogamy.s: The law requires monogamy: one husband, one wife.
monogamy.zh: 法律要求一夫一妻制：一个丈夫，一个妻子。

polygyny.s: In polygyny, one man has several wives.
polygyny.zh: 在一夫多妻制中，一个男人有好几个妻子。

miscegenation.s: Laws against miscegenation once stopped black and white people from marrying.
miscegenation.zh: 禁止异族通婚的法律曾经阻止黑人和白人结婚。

full-blood.s: Tom and his full-blood brother share both parents.
full-blood.zh: 汤姆和他的全血缘兄弟有共同的父母。

half-blood.s: Mary and her half-blood sister have the same mother only.
half-blood.zh: 玛丽和她的半血缘姐妹只是同一个母亲。

ambit.s: The case falls within the ambit of family law.
ambit.zh: 本案属于家庭法的范围。

credence.s: The jury gave no credence to his story.
credence.zh: 陪审团没有采信他的说法。

squarely.s: The court faced the question squarely.
squarely.zh: 法院正面面对了这个问题。

quagmire.s: The divorce turned into a legal quagmire.
quagmire.zh: 这场离婚变成了一个法律困境。

civil union.s: The couple entered a civil union instead of a marriage.
civil union.zh: 这对伴侣缔结了民事结合，而不是婚姻。

incest.s: Marriage between a brother and sister is incest.
incest.zh: 兄妹之间的婚姻属于乱伦。

solemnize.s: A priest solemnized their marriage in the church.
solemnize.zh: 一位牧师在教堂里为他们举行了婚姻仪式。

validation.s: The couple sought validation of their marriage in another state.
validation.zh: 这对夫妇寻求在另一个州确认他们的婚姻有效。

percolate.s: The new idea slowly percolated through society.
percolate.zh: 这个新观念慢慢渗透到整个社会。

claimant.s: The claimant asked for money for her injuries.
claimant.zh: 请求权人要求就她受的伤获得赔偿。

procreate.s: Some argued that marriage exists so couples can procreate.
procreate.zh: 有些人认为婚姻的存在是为了让夫妻生育。

vilification.s: The singer suffered vilification in the press.
vilification.zh: 这位歌手在媒体上遭到诋毁。

originalist.s: As an originalist, the judge studies what the founders meant.
originalist.zh: 作为原旨主义者，这位法官研究开国元勋们的本意。

posit.s: The writer posits that crime is caused by poverty.
posit.zh: 作者主张犯罪是由贫困造成的。

subvert.s: The rebels tried to subvert the government.

pundit.s: TV pundits argued about the court's decision all night.
pundit.zh: 电视评论家们整晚都在争论法院的判决。

indefensible.s: His cruel behavior was simply indefensible.
indefensible.zh: 他的残忍行为完全站不住脚。

legality.s: Lawyers questioned the legality of the new tax.
legality.zh: 律师们质疑新税的合法性。

retroactive.s: The pay raise is retroactive to January.
retroactive.zh: 这次加薪是溯及既往的，从一月算起。

orientation.s: The law bans job discrimination based on sexual orientation.
orientation.zh: 这项法律禁止基于性取向的就业歧视。

scruple.s: He had no scruple about lying to the police.
scruple.zh: 他对向警察撒谎毫无顾忌。

bigamy.s: He was charged with bigamy for having two wives.
bigamy.zh: 他因有两个妻子被控重婚。

ceremonial.s: The mayor's role at the opening was only ceremonial.
ceremonial.zh: 市长在开幕式上的角色只是仪式性的。

spousal support.s: After the divorce, he paid spousal support to his former wife.
spousal support.zh: 离婚后，他向前妻支付配偶扶养费。

vagary.s: Farmers must deal with the vagaries of the weather.
vagary.zh: 农民必须应对变幻莫测的天气。

minutiae.s: The judge did not care about the minutiae of the contract.
minutiae.zh: 法官并不关心合同的细枝末节。

trier of fact.s: The jury is the trier of fact in most trials.
trier of fact.zh: 在大多数审判中，陪审团是事实审理者。

facetious.s: His facetious remark made the judge angry.
facetious.zh: 他戏谑的话惹恼了法官。

child support.s: The father must pay child support every month.
child support.zh: 父亲每月必须支付抚养费。

desertion.s: She asked for a divorce because of her husband's desertion.
desertion.zh: 她以丈夫遗弃为由请求离婚。

collaborative.s: The parents took a collaborative approach to raising their son.
collaborative.zh: 父母以合作的方式抚养儿子。

equitably.s: The court divided the property equitably between them.
equitably.zh: 法院在他们之间公平地分割了财产。

pendency.s: During the pendency of the divorce, the children stayed with their mother.
pendency.zh: 在离婚案处于待决状态期间，孩子们和母亲住在一起。

overreaching.s: The court found overreaching because the rich husband tricked his wife.
overreaching.zh: 法院认定存在过分行为，因为富有的丈夫欺骗了妻子。

garner.s: The new law garnered wide public support.
garner.zh: 新法律赢得了广泛的公众支持。

tenant in common.s: As a tenant in common, she can sell her share freely.
tenant in common.zh: 作为普通共有人，她可以自由出售自己的份额。

joint tenant.s: When one joint tenant dies, the other gets the whole house.
joint tenant.zh: 一位共同保有人去世后，另一位得到整栋房子。

aforementioned.s: The aforementioned rules apply to all students.
aforementioned.zh: 上述规则适用于所有学生。

calumny.s: He was the victim of calumny spread by his enemies.
calumny.zh: 他是敌人散布的诽谤的受害者。

payable.s: The rent is payable on the first day of each month.
payable.zh: 租金应在每月第一天支付。

lump-sum.s: He received a lump-sum payment instead of monthly checks.
lump-sum.zh: 他得到了一次性支付的款项，而不是每月的支票。

installment.s: She paid for the car in twelve monthly installments.
installment.zh: 她分十二个月分期付款买了车。

torment.s: The older boys tormented the new student.
torment.zh: 大男孩们折磨那个新来的学生。

mistreat.s: The man was arrested for mistreating his dog.
mistreat.zh: 该男子因虐待他的狗而被捕。

contestant.s: Each contestant in the custody fight wanted the child.
contestant.zh: 监护权之争中的每个争夺方都想要这个孩子。

relitigation.s: The rule prevents relitigation of the same case.
relitigation.zh: 这条规则防止对同一案件重新诉讼。

legal custody.s: Both parents share legal custody, so they decide about school together.
legal custody.zh: 父母双方共同依法监护孩子，所以他们共同决定上学的事。

physical custody.s: The mother has physical custody, so the child lives with her.
physical custody.zh: 母亲拥有实际监护权，所以孩子和她住在一起。

parentage.s: A blood test settled the question of the child's parentage.
parentage.zh: 血液检测解决了孩子的父母身份问题。

biological.s: He met his biological mother for the first time at twenty.
biological.zh: 他二十岁时第一次见到自己的亲生母亲。

reprieve.s: The family got a reprieve when the bank delayed the sale.
reprieve.zh: 银行推迟了出售，这家人得到了暂缓。

nonsupport.s: He was jailed for nonsupport of his children.
nonsupport.zh: 他因不供养子女而入狱。

registry.s: The state keeps a registry of all births.
registry.zh: 州政府设有登记所有出生信息的登记处。

surrogate.s: A surrogate mother carried the baby for the couple.
surrogate.zh: 一位代孕母亲为这对夫妇怀了孩子。

surrogacy.s: Some states do not allow paid surrogacy.
surrogacy.zh: 有些州不允许有偿代孕。

wedlock.s: The child was born out of wedlock.
wedlock.zh: 这个孩子是在婚姻之外出生的。

bastard.s: In old law, a bastard had no right to his father's land.
bastard.zh: 在旧法律中，私生子无权继承父亲的土地。

natural father.s: The boy wanted to find his natural father.
natural father.zh: 这个男孩想找到他的生父。

pariah.s: After the scandal, he became a pariah in town.
pariah.zh: 丑闻之后，他成了镇上的被排斥者。

conception.s: Doctors can tell the date of conception from the tests.
conception.zh: 医生可以通过检查得知开始妊娠的日期。

insemination.s: The couple used artificial insemination to have a baby.
insemination.zh: 这对夫妇通过人工授精生了孩子。

gestational.s: The gestational mother carried another couple's baby.
gestational.zh: 这位妊娠母亲怀着另一对夫妇的孩子。

offspring.s: The man left all his money to his offspring.
offspring.zh: 这个人把所有的钱都留给了他的子孙。

parenthood.s: Parenthood brings both joy and duty.
parenthood.zh: 为人父母既带来快乐也带来责任。

putative.s: The putative father asked for a blood test.
putative.zh: 推定的父亲要求进行血液检测。

filiation.s: The court ruled on the boy's filiation to the man.
filiation.zh: 法院就这个男孩与该男子的亲子关系作出了裁决。

succor.s: The church gave succor to the poor.

adoptive.s: Her adoptive parents raised her with love.
adoptive.zh: 收养她的父母用爱把她抚养长大。

nebulous.s: The rule was so nebulous that judges read it differently.
nebulous.zh: 这条规则太模糊，法官们的理解各不相同。

foster care.s: The children were placed in foster care after their mother died.
foster care.zh: 母亲去世后，孩子们被安置到寄养家庭。

shroud.s: The details of the adoption were shrouded in secrecy.
shroud.zh: 收养的细节被笼罩在秘密之中。

cardinal.s: Honesty is the cardinal rule of this court.
cardinal.zh: 诚实是这个法院的首要规则。

weighty.s: The judge must consider several weighty questions.
weighty.zh: 法官必须考虑几个重要的问题。

accede.s: The landlord acceded to the tenant's request.
accede.zh: 房东同意了租户的请求。

relinquishment.s: The mother signed a relinquishment of her parental rights.
relinquishment.zh: 母亲签署了放弃亲权的文件。

cooling-off.s: The law gives buyers a three-day cooling-off period.
cooling-off.zh: 法律给买方三天的冷却期。

outcry.s: The judge's light punishment caused a public outcry.
outcry.zh: 法官的轻判引发了公众的强烈抗议。

castigate.s: The newspaper castigated the mayor for his lies.
castigate.zh: 报纸严厉批评了市长的谎言。

intrude.s: The state should not intrude into family life.
intrude.zh: 国家不应干涉家庭生活。

battered.s: The shelter helps battered women and their children.
battered.zh: 这个庇护所帮助受虐待的妇女和她们的孩子。

configuration.s: The configuration of American families has changed a lot.
configuration.zh: 美国家庭的结构发生了很大的变化。

coherent.s: The witness could not give a coherent account of the night.
coherent.zh: 证人无法连贯地叙述那天晚上的情况。

pastime.s: Fishing is his favorite pastime on weekends.
pastime.zh: 钓鱼是他周末最喜欢的消遣。

evaporate.s: His support evaporated after the scandal.
evaporate.zh: 丑闻之后，他得到的支持消失了。

imperceptible.s: The change in the law was almost imperceptible.
imperceptible.zh: 法律的变化几乎难以察觉。

oppressor.s: The people finally rose up against their oppressor.
oppressor.zh: 人民终于起来反抗压迫者。

recalcitrant.s: The recalcitrant father refused to pay child support.
recalcitrant.zh: 那个拒不服从的父亲拒绝支付子女抚养费。

noncustodial.s: The noncustodial parent sees the children on weekends.
noncustodial.zh: 无监护权的一方父母在周末探望孩子。

intolerable.s: The noise from the factory was intolerable.
intolerable.zh: 工厂的噪音令人无法容忍。

inseparable.s: In law, rights and duties are inseparable.
inseparable.zh: 在法律上，权利和义务是不可分的。

overrepresented.s: Poor people are overrepresented in the prison population.
overrepresented.zh: 穷人在监狱人口中所占比例过高。

politicize.s: Critics say the president politicized the courts.
politicize.zh: 批评者说总统使法院政治化了。

dominance.s: The company used its dominance to push out small rivals.
dominance.zh: 这家公司利用其支配地位排挤小竞争者。

perseverance.s: Her perseverance finally won her the case.
perseverance.zh: 她的毅力最终使她赢得了官司。

status quo.s: The court wanted to keep the status quo until the trial.
status quo.zh: 法院希望在审判前维持事物的现时状态。

vigor.s: The police enforced the new law with vigor.

clout.s: Big companies have a lot of political clout.
clout.zh: 大公司有很大的政治影响力。

subsidize.s: The government subsidizes farmers who grow wheat.
subsidize.zh: 政府补贴种植小麦的农民。

beleaguered.s: The beleaguered mayor faced new questions every day.
beleaguered.zh: 处境艰难的市长每天都要面对新的质问。

reiterate.s: The judge reiterated her warning to the lawyer.
reiterate.zh: 法官向律师重申了她的警告。

decriminalization.s: Some people support the decriminalization of drug use.
decriminalization.zh: 有些人支持吸毒非犯罪化。

eviction.s: The family faced eviction after missing three months of rent.
eviction.zh: 这家人拖欠了三个月房租，面临被驱逐。

irreparable.s: The fire caused irreparable damage to the old church.
irreparable.zh: 大火给这座老教堂造成了无法弥补的损害。

plague.s: Money problems plagued the company for years.
plague.zh: 资金问题困扰这家公司多年。

prohibitive.s: The cost of a lawyer is prohibitive for many poor people.
prohibitive.zh: 对许多穷人来说，请律师的费用高得令人却步。

gross negligence.s: Leaving a baby alone in a hot car is gross negligence.
gross negligence.zh: 把婴儿单独留在炎热的车里是重大过失。

determinist.s: A determinist believes people cannot choose their actions freely.
determinist.zh: 决定论者认为人不能自由地选择自己的行为。

righteousness.s: He believed in the righteousness of his cause.
righteousness.zh: 他相信自己事业的正义性。

avarice.s: His avarice led him to cheat his own family.
avarice.zh: 他的贪婪使他欺骗了自己的家人。

disavow.s: The leader disavowed any part in the attack.
disavow.zh: 领导人否认参与了这次袭击。

brutish.s: Life without law would be short and brutish.
brutish.zh: 没有法律的生活将是短暂而野蛮的。

wrath.s: The boy feared his father's wrath.
wrath.zh: 男孩害怕他父亲的愤怒。

herein.s: The rules stated herein apply to all tenants.
herein.zh: 此处所述的规则适用于所有租户。
